portfolio.text:
Göz Çevresi Estetiği İstanbul

Göz çevresi estetiği İstanbul, göz çevresinde; ilerleyen yaşa ve benzer faktörlere bağlı meydana gelen estetik sorunları gidermek için yapılan operasyondur. Göz çevresinde mimiklerin ve göz hareketlerinin ortaya çıkmasını sağlayan pek çok doku yer almaktadır. Gerek bu dokuların yoğun biçimde kullanılması gerekse de çevresel etmenler sebebiyle göz çevresinde kırışıklıklar, cilt fazlalıkları, sarkıklık, ve torbalar meydana gelebilir. Bu kırışıklıklardan bazıları kaz ayağı çizgileri veya kaz ayağı kırışıklıkları olarak bilinir. Göz çevresi estetiği sayesinde bu gibi kırışıklıklar, sarkmalar, torbalanmalar ve benzer estetik problemler ortadan kaldırılabilir.

Yazımızın devamında ‘’Göz çevresi estetiği ne kadar sürer?’’, ‘’Göz çevresi estetiği nasıl yapılır?’’, ‘’Göz çevresi estetiği kimlere yapılabilir?’’ ve ‘’Göz çevresi estetiği kalıcı mı?’’ gibi merak edilen sorulara yanıt vereceğiz. İstanbul göz çevresi estetiği ve göz çevresi ameliyatı hakkında detaylı bilgi için Op. Dr. Alper Burak Uslu ile iletişime geçebilir, randevu alabilirsiniz.

Göz Çevresi Estetiği Nedir?

Göz çevresi estetiği, göz çevresinde meydana gelen estetik problemlerin giderilebilmesi, göz çevresinde beliren yaşlı ve yorgun görünümün ortadan kaldırılabilmesi için yapılan özel bir operasyondur. Göz çevresinde, mimiklerin ve yüz ifadelerinin oluşmasından sorumlu bazı dokular yer alır. Gerek bu dokuların sık kullanımı gerekse de ilerleyen yaş gibi etmenler sebebiyle göz çevresinde, kaz ayağı kırışıklıkları olarak isimlendirilen çizgiler meydana gelebilir. Hem bu çizgiler hem de göz altı torbaları gibi estetik problemler bireyin olduğundan daha yaşlı ve yorgun görünmesine yol açarlar. Göz çevresi estetiği bu gibi problemleri gidermek için yapılır.

Göz Çevresi Estetiği Neden Yapılır?

Göz çevresi estetiği şu gibi nedenlerden yapılabilir:

• Göz çevresinde meydana gelen sarkmaları ve kırışıklıkları ortadan kaldırmak.

• Göz çevresinin canlı ve genç bir görünüm kazanmasını sağlamak.

• Göz altı torbalarını ve kaz ayağı kırışıklıklarını gidermek.

• Göz kapakları ve kaşlar ile ilgili estetik problemleri ortadan kaldırmak.

• Yüz ile uyumlu ve çekici bir göz görünümü meydana getirmek.

Göz çevresi estetiği bahsi geçen amaçlar doğrultusunda yapılabilir.

Göz Çevresi Estetiği Kimlere Yapılır?

Göz çevresi estetiği 18 yaşından daha küçük olan bireylere önerilmez. Bu operasyon sırasında genellikle işlevsel değil, estetik amaçlı gerçekleşen cerrahi işlemler kullanılır. Bu yüzden de reşit olmayan bireylerin göz çevresi estetiği yaptırmaları uygun değildir.

Göz Çevresi Estetiği Ağrılı Mı?

Göz çevresi estetiği ağrılı bir operasyon değildir. Ameliyat sırasında hastaya anestezi uygulanır. Böylece hasta herhangi bir ağrı veya rahatsızlık hissi duymaz. Göz çevresi estetiği sırasında kullanılan anestezi yöntemi, ameliyat sırasında gerçekleştirilecek işlemlerin detaylarına göre değişiklik gösterebilir.

Göz Çevresi Estetiği İstanbul Kalıcı Mı?

Göz çevresi estetiği ile elde edilen kazanımlar büyük oranda kalıcıdır. Ancak ameliyat sonrasında doktor tarafından verilen tavsiyelere özenle uyulmalıdır. Sigara ve diğer tütün ürünleri yara iyileşme sürecini olumsuz etkilediği için kullanılmamalı, gözler ovuşturulmamalı ve gözlere zarar veren davranışlardan uzak durulmalıdır. Aksi takdirde göz çevresi estetiği ile elde edilen kazanımlar kaybedilebilir.

Göz Çevresi Estetiği Ne Kadar Sürer?

Göz çevresi estetiği, operasyon sırasında yapılan işlemlere göre farklı sürelerde tamamlanabilir. Bazı durumlarda operasyon 45 dakika gibi kısa bir sürede tamamlanır. Bazı durumlarda ise operasyonun süresi 3 saati bulabilir. Bu süre doktorun hastaya özel hazırladığı ameliyat planlamasının kapsamına göre değişiklik gösterebilir. Doktorunuz konu hakkında sizi detaylı olarak bilgilendirecektir.

Göz Çevresi Estetiği İstanbul Nasıl Yapılır?

Göz çevresi estetiği sırasında pek çok işleme başvurulabilir. Bu işlemlerin başında özel cerrahi kesi ve dikiş teknikleri yer alır. Bu teknikler kullanılarak göz çevresindeki fazla dokular alınır ve kalanlar ise düzenlenir. Bazı durumlarda yağ enjeksiyonu gibi işlemlere de başvurulabilir. Planlanan işlemler tamamlandıktan sonra ameliyat başarı ile sonlandırılır. Göz çevresi estetiği sırasında genellikle lokal anesteziye başvurulur, bu yüzden ameliyat sırasında ağrı hissedilmez.

Göz Çevresi Estetiği Sonrası İyileşme Süreci Nasıldır?

Göz çevresi estetiği yaptıran bireyler genelde aynı gün taburcu olurlar, bazense 1 gece kadar hastanede kalmaları gerekebilir. Taburcu olan hastalar 1 ila 2 hafta içerisinde büyük oranda iyileşir ve günlük yaşamlarına dönerler. Bu süreçte göze zarar verebilecek en küçük davranışlardan bile kaçınılmalıdır.

Sigara ve diğer tütün ürünleri yara iyileşme sürecini olumsuz etkilediği için kullanılmamalı, gözler ovuşturulmamalı ve gözlere zarar veren davranışlardan uzak durulmalıdır. Aksi takdirde göz çevresi estetiği ile elde edilen kazanımlar kaybedilebilir.

faq.q: Göz Çevresi Estetiği Ne Kadar Sürer?
faq.a: Göz çevresi estetiği, operasyon sırasında yapılan işlemlere göre farklı sürelerde tamamlanabilir. Bazı durumlarda operasyon 45 dakika gibi kısa bir sürede tamamlanır. Bazı durumlarda ise operasyonun süresi 3 saati bulabilir. Bu süre doktorun hastaya özel hazırladığı ameliyat planlamasının kapsamına göre değişiklik gösterebilir. Doktorunuz konu hakkında sizi detaylı olarak bilgilendirecektir.

faq.q: Göz Çevresi Estetiği İstanbul Nasıl Yapılır?
faq.a: Göz çevresi estetiği sırasında pek çok işleme başvurulabilir. Bu işlemlerin başında özel cerrahi kesi ve dikiş teknikleri yer alır. Bu teknikler kullanılarak göz çevresindeki fazla dokular alınır ve kalanlar ise düzenlenir. Bazı durumlarda yağ enjeksiyonu gibi işlemlere de başvurulabilir. Planlanan işlemler tamamlandıktan sonra ameliyat başarı ile sonlandırılır. Göz çevresi estetiği sırasında genellikle lokal anesteziye başvurulur, bu yüzden ameliyat sırasında ağrı hissedilmez.

faq.q: Göz Çevresi Estetiği Sonrası İyileşme Süreci Nasıldır?
faq.a: Göz çevresi estetiği yaptıran bireyler genelde aynı gün taburcu olurlar, bazense 1 gece kadar hastanede kalmaları gerekebilir. Taburcu olan hastalar 1 ila 2 hafta içerisinde büyük oranda iyileşir ve günlük yaşamlarına dönerler. Bu süreçte göze zarar verebilecek en küçük davranışlardan bile kaçınılmalıdır.

portfolio.text:
Botoks İstanbul

Botoks İstanbul, cilt kırışıklıklarını ortadan kaldırmak, cilde pürüzsüz ve genç bir görünüm kazandırmak amacıyla yapılan özel bir uygulamadır. Yüz cildinin altında yüz ifadelerinin ve mimiklerin oluşmasını sağlayan kas dokuları yer alır. Bu dokuların aşırı kullanımı ve ilerleyen yaş gibi faktörler sebebiyle zaman içerisinde cilt yüzeyinde kırışıklıklar ve çizgiler meydana gelebilir. Botoks uygulaması bu kırışıklıkların ve çizgilerin giderilmesi, cildin çekici bir görünüm kazanması amacıyla gerçekleştirilir. Bu uygulama aşırı terleme gibi sorunları ortadan kaldırmak için de yaygın olarak tercih edilmektedir. Yazımızın devamında ‘’Botoks nasıl yapılır?’’, ‘’Botoks ne kadar sürer?’’, ‘’Botoks İstanbul sonrası dikkat edilmesi gerekenler nelerdir?’’ ve ‘’Botoks İstanbul hangi bölgelere yapılabilir?’’ gibi merak edilen sorulara yanıt vereceğiz. İstanbul botoks uygulaması ve benzer ameliyatsız estetik işlemleri hakkında detaylı bilgi için Op. Dr. Alper Burak Uslu ile iletişime geçebilir, randevu alabilirsiniz.

Botoks Nedir?

Botoks, botulinum toksin isimli özel bir sıvı yardımıyla yapılan hem ülkemizde hem de dünyada en çok tercih edilen ameliyatsız estetik uygulamalarından biri olan işlemdir. Bu işlem sayesinde pek çok vücut bölgesindeki kırışıklıkları ve çizgileri ortadan kaldırmak mümkün olmaktadır. Alanında uzman bir estetik cerrahi hekimi tarafından yapıldığı takdirde son derece güvenli olan bu uygulama, günümüzde özel muayenehanelerde, özel hastanelerde ve özel kliniklerde yaptırılabilmektedir.

Botoks İstanbul Neden Yapılır?

Botoks işlemi pek çok farklı amaç doğrultusunda yapılabilir. Bu amaçlardan en yaygın olanı hedef bölgede, özellikle de yüz bölgesinde yer alan kırışıklıklardan ve çizgilerden kurtulmaktır. Bununla birlikte migren atakları sırasında hissedilen baş ağrısının şiddetini veya sıklığını azaltmak için de botoks tedavisine başvurulabilir. Aynı şekilde aşırı terleme sorununu ortadan kaldırmak amacıyla da botoks işlemi yapılabilir. Doktorunuz, botoksun talep edilme amacı ne olursa olsun tüm işlemleri sizin ihtiyaçlarınıza ve taleplerine özel olarak planlayacaktır.

Botoks Kimlere Yapılır?

Botoks işlemi çoğunlukla kozmetik ve estetik amaçlar doğrultusunda gerçekleştirilir. Bu yüzden de pek çok estetik uygulama gibi, botoksun da reşit olmayan bireylere yapılması önerilmez. 18 yaşını doldurmuş olan bireyler iste istedikleri zaman, talep dahilinde botoks yaptırabilirler. Bununla birlikte botoks yaptırmayı planladıkları bölgede açık bir yaranın veya aktif bir enfeksiyonun var olmaması gerekir. Aksi takdirde botoks işlemi bir süreliğine ertelenebilir.

Botoks İstanbul Hangi Bölgelere Yapılır?

Botoks işlemi şu gibi bölgelere uygulanabilir:

• Kaz ayağı kırışıklıklarını yok etmek için göz çevresine.

• Burun çevresinde yer alan kırışıkları ve çizgileri gidermek için burun çevresine.

• Ağız ve dudak çevresinde yer alan çizgileri ortadan kaldırmak için ağız çevresine.

• Alındaki çizgiler için alın bölgesine.

• Elmacık kemiği çevresindeki estetik problemler için yanak bölgesine.

• Aşırı terleme sorununu gidermek için koltuk altlarına ve yüz bölgelerine.

• Botoksla migren tedavisi kapsamında alın ve şakak civarına.

Botoks işlemi bu gibi bölgelere uygulanabilir.

Botoksun Faydaları Nelerdir?

Botoksun faydaları arasında şunlar yer almaktadır:

• Kırışıklıkları ve çizgileri gidermek için son derece etkilidir.

• Bölgede yer alan kas dokusunun aşırı miktarda çalışmasını ve buna bağlı olarak kalınlaşmasını önler. Böylece hedef bölgedeki cilt dokusu kırışmamış ve yıpranmamış olur.

• Bireyin canlı, pürüzsüz ve çekici bir cilt görünüme kavuşmasını sağlar.

• Kasların kontrollü bir biçimde gevşemesini ve cildin daha çekici bir görünüm kazanmasını sağlar.

Botoksun faydaları bu şekilde sıralanabilir.

Botoks İstanbul Kalıcı Mı?

Botoksun etkileri kalıcı değildir, zamanla kaybolurlar. Bu etkiler genelde 4 ila 6 ay boyunca kalır ve daha sonra ise zamanla kaybedilirler. Bahsi geçen süre bireyin cilt tipine, yaşam tarzına ve beslenme alışkanlıklarına göre değişiklik gösterebilir.

Botoks Tekrarlanabilir Mi?

Daha önce botoks yaptırmış olan bireyler, talep dahilinde botoks işlemlerini yeniletebilirler. Bu işlem genelde 6 ayda bir tekrarlanmaktadır. Doktorunuz botoks işleminin hangi aralıklarla tekrarlanabileceği gibi konular hakkında sizi detaylı olarak bilgilendirecektir.

Botoks İstanbul Ne Kadar Sürer?

Botoks işlemi yaklaşık 15 dakika içerisinde son bulur. Doktor, bu işlem öncesinde tamamen hastasına özel bir botoks planlaması yapar. Bu yüzden botoks sırasında tüm işlemler bu planlama dahilinde, hızlıca gerçekleştirilir.

Botoks İstanbul Nasıl Yapılır?

Botoks işlemi, ameliyatsız estetik uygulamalar arasında hasta için en konforlu ve ağrısız uygulamalardan biridir. Bu uygulamanın ilk adımında, botoks iğnesinin yapılacağı cilt bölgesine anestezi etkisi taşıyan bir krem uygulanır. Kremin etkileri başladıktan sonra ise hedef bölgeye botoks sıvısı enjekte edilir ve uygulama tamamlanır. Botoks yaptıran bireyler işlem tamamlandıktan sonra kaldıkları yerden hayatlarına devam edebilirler.

İstanbul Botoks Fiyatları

İstanbul botoks fiyatları 2025 ve botox ücreti gibi konular hakkında detaylı bilgi için Op. Dr. Alper Burak Uslu ile iletişime geçebilirsiniz.

pages.title: About Me
pages.text:
Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS)

Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery Specialist

Dr. Alper Burak Uslu was born in Ankara in 1988. He completed his primary,  middle and high school education at Ankara Private Tevfik Fikret Schools and was awarded the “Baccalauréat Français” (French high school graduation diploma). Although he was accepted from Montpellier University Faculty of Medicine, which is considered the oldest medical school in the world, he started his medical education at Ankara Başkent University Faculty of Medicine in 2005 and graduated in 2011 and was awarded the title of “Doctor of Medicine”.

He showed high success in the medical specialty exam and was placed in Ankara Numune Training and Research Hospital’s (ANH) Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery department in 2012 and completed his specialty training in the same clinic, in 2017. During these years, he attended many congresses and trainings. In 2014, he received microsurgery training at Goethe Universität Frankfurt, Germany. During his residency, he performed numerous operations in the fields of Aesthetic surgery, Hand surgery, Reconstructive microsurgery, Oral & maxillofacial surgery, Burns, Head & Neck cancer surgery and reconstructions, lower extremity trauma and reconstructions. In 2017, he participated in the two-stage written and oral qualification exams organized by the Turkish Society of Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery and the European Board of Plastic Surgery (EBOPRAS) in 2018, and successfully passed them on the first attempt and received the Turkish and European Board Qualification.

Dr. Alper Burak Uslu performed his compulsory service as a medical specialist in Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery at Karaman State Hospital between 2018-2020, worked at Istanbul Haseki Training and Research Hospital between 2020-2021 and took part in the education of assistant physicians as well as his academic studies. In September 2021, his Medical Education credentials were verified by the state administration of Münster, Germany. In 2021, he left his obligatory service and started to work mainly in the field of Aesthetic Surgery within the Vanity Cosmetic Surgery Hospital and continues to work in the field of Aesthetic Surgery as a freelance physician. Dr. Uslu, who sets perfection as the ultimate goal, thinks that surgeons should constantly update themselves and push their limits in order to achieve their goal and provide the best possible treatment to patients.

He has many scientific articles published in domestic and international peer-reviewed journals as well as numerous presentations in national and international congresses. He is a member of International Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgeons (ISAPS), American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS), European Board of Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery (EBOPRAS), Aesthetic Plastic Surgery Association (EPCD) and Turkish Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery Association (TPRECD). He speaks fluent English, French & German.

Alper Burak Uslu, M.D, FEBOPRAS

Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery

Dr. Uslu is a distinguished European and Turkish double Board Certified Plastic Surgeon. He is among the top plastic surgeons of his generation. His level of qualification and expertise is documented through intensive board certifications of international bodies. A proud member of several esteemed organizations including the International Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgeons (ISAPS), American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS), Turkish Society of Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery, and Turkish Society of Aesthetic Surgery, he is also a Fellow of the European Board of Plastic Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery (EBOPRAS).

Dr. Uslu graduated from Baskent University Medical School in Ankara in 2011 and completed his 6-year residency traning in Plastic, Reconstructive, and Aesthetic Surgery at Ankara Numune Research and Education Hospital in 2017. He has further honed his skills with advanced microsurgical training at Goethe University in Frankfurt, Germany. With a special interest and expertise in aesthetic surgery of the face and breast, body contouring, medical aesthetics, reconstructive microsurgery, and hand surgery, Dr. Uslu has authored numerous international papers published in peer-reviewed journals.

His work has garnered over 35 citations worldwide. Over his 12-year career, he has performed more than 2000 aesthetic procedures and over 4000 plastic surgical operations, consistently demonstrating his commitment to excellence and patient care.” Read more…

portfolio.text:
Breast Reduction Surgery Turkey

Breast reduction surgery Turkey is performed for purposes such as removing excess fat and skin tissue from the breasts and eliminating problems arising from large breasts such as back pain. There is a misconception among the public that big breasts always create an attractive or more feminine appearance. However, what makes breasts attractive most of the time is that they have a structure that is compatible with each other and body measurements such as shoulder width. Some individuals may have breasts that are much larger than what is considered ideal. This causes some problems, both aesthetic and functional. Breast reduction aesthetics is performed to eliminate these problems. In the rest of our article, we will be answering FAQs such as “Why is breast reduction performed?”, “How long does breast reduction surgery take?”, “Who can undergo breast reduction surgery?” and “Can breastfeeding be performed after breast reduction?”.

For detailed information about Turkey breast reduction surgery and similar operations, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Breast Reduction?

Breast reduction is an operation performed to reduce the size of the breasts in line with the individual’s demands and aesthetic criterias, and to eliminate problems such as sagging and lower back pain that occur due to large breasts. Thanks to this operation, the individual can have attractive breasts that are compatible with their body size. Moreover, it is possible to perform this operation together with breast lift surgery. Thus, the breasts gain an upright and aesthetically pleasing appearance that is compatible with each other and body size.

Why is Breast Reduction Done?

Breast reduction may be performed for purposes such as:

• Reducing the breasts so that they are compatible with body measurements such as shoulder width.

• To eliminate the size difference between breasts.

• To give the breasts an attractive shape.

• Eliminating back and neck pain caused by large breasts.

Breast reduction aesthetics can be performed due to the aforementioned reasons.

Who Can Have Breast Reduction?

Plastic surgery operations such as breast reduction surgery are only performed on individuals who are of legal age. Individuals who are of legal age and have completed breast development can have breast reduction whenever they want, upon request. However, it is recommended that women who are pregnant or breastfeeding have this operation after the mentioned processes are completed. Likewise, if the individual plans to become pregnant in the near future, it is recommended to have breast augmentation surgery after pregnancy, birth and breastfeeding.

Can Breastfeeding Be Performed After Breast Reduction Turkey?

It is possible for women who have had breast reduction to breastfeed their babies after the recovery process is completed. Contrary to popular belief, important tissues that make breastfeeding possible, such as mammary glands and milk ducts, are not damaged during breast surgeries such as breast reduction. Therefore, individuals who have had breast reduction can breastfeed their babies after giving birth.

Can Breast Reduction and Breast Lift Be Done Together?

Breast lift surgery can be performed together with breast reduction surgery. Thus, breasts can be both reduced and lifted in a single operation.

Is Breast Reduction Surgery Risky?

Breast reduction surgery carries some risks, like all other surgical operations. However, most of these risks can be eliminated by choosing the right doctor who carries their surgeries in an ideal operating room environment.

How Long Does Breast Reduction Surgery Take?

The duration of breast reduction surgery may vary depending on the size of the breasts, the method preferred during the operation and similar factors. This operation is usually completed within 2 to 4 hours. Your doctor will prepare a special breast reduction surgery plan for you and will inform you in detail about how long the operation will take.

How is Breast Reduction Surgery Turkey Performed?

Breast reduction surgery Turkey can be performed under general or local anaesthesia. The operation is performed under sterile operating room conditions, within the scope of a personalized surgery plan prepared by the doctor. Special techniques such as “Inverted T” or “Lollipop Incision” may be used during the operation. Thanks to these techniques, excess fat and skin tissue from the breasts are removed. The incisions used during the procedure are closed with special aesthetic stitching procedures and the operation ends. Individuals do not feel pain or discomfort during the operation.

What is the Recovery Process After Breast Reduction Surgery?

After breast reduction surgery Turkey, it is possible for the individual to be discharged on the same day or to be hospitalized overnight. Patients who are discharged are advised to take a break from their daily routines and not engage in heavy or strenuous activities for about a week. Afterwards, you can return to daily life in accordance with the doctor’s recommendation.

Turkey Breast Reduction Surgery Prices

You can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS) for further information and up-to-date prices about the Turkey Breast Reduction Surgery.

portfolio.text:
Piezo Rhinoplasty Turkey

Piezo rhinoplasty Turkey is an advanced technique used in rhinoplasty surgeries. In rhinoplasty surgeries with traditional/classical approaches, physical force is used to shape tissues such as the nasal bone and eliminate deformities in these tissues. This results in the surrounding tissues being affected to an extent by these procedures, resulting in bruising and swelling around the nose after surgery. In the piezo rhinoplasty technique, concentrated sound/Ultrasonic waves are used to shape the tissues in question. Thus, only target tissues are intervened. Thanks to this application, it is possible to perform much more gentle procedures on the nose. In the rest of our article, we will be answering FAQs such as “How is Piezo rhinoplasty performed?”, “How long does Piezo rhinoplasty last?”, “Who can undergo Piezo rhinoplasty?” and “What is the recovery process like after Piezo rhinoplasty.

For detailed information about Turkey piezo rhinoplasty and similar operations, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Piezo aka Precision Rhinoplasty?

Piezo rhinoplasty is a modern and advantageous nose aesthetic operation in many aspects, allowing the nasal tissues to be shaped with ultrasonic sound waves. Thanks to this operation, there is no need to use physical force while shaping the nasal bone. In this way, other nasal tissues or tissues around the nose are not worn or damaged during the surgery. With Piezo rhinoplasty, crookedness, humps, bumps and deformities in the nasal bone can be carefully eliminated. The shaping of the nose can be carried out extremely precisely. This special rhinoplasty technique is preferred by more and more patients and surgeons every day.

Why is Piezo Rhinoplasty Performed?

Piezo rhinoplasty can be performed for purposes such as:

• To eliminate problems related to the nasal bone without damaging the soft tissues around the nose.

• Eliminating the appearance of the hump on the nose.

• To create an aesthetic harmony between the face and nose.

• Correcting nasal bone deformities.

• Lifting the tip of the nose.

• Reducing the nose to be more compatible with the face.

Piezo rhinoplasty can be performed for the reasons mentioned.

Who Can Have Piezo Rhinoplasty Turkey?

Piezo rhinoplasty operation can be performed on individuals who want to have nose surgery but are afraid of post-operative bruises and swelling. It is normal to see a certain amount of swelling and bruising after this operation as well, however, these are fewer than the complications encountered after rhinoplasty operations with traditional approach and they disappear much more quickly. Any individual over the age of 18 can have piezo rhinoplasty upon request. This operation can be performed on both men and women.

The advantages of piezo rhinoplasty include:

• This operation is performed with extreme precision.

• Procedures based on physical force are not performed during the operation. Therefore, other tissues are not damaged.

• Since soft tissues are not damaged, complaints such as bruising and swelling are less common.

• The healing process is much more comfortable and faster.

The advantages of piezo rhinoplasty can be listed as above.

Before piezo rhinoplasty surgery, the patient is anaesthetized. The type and details of this anaesthesia procedure are determined according to the scope of the operation. The patient does not feel pain or discomfort during the operation. Thus, the operation is performed safely and ideally.

Piezo rhinoplasty Turkey can take up to 4 to 5 hours. However, some small-scale operations can be completed in a relatively short time, such as 2 hours. Your doctor will give detailed information about the duration of piezo rhinoplasty and similar issues before the surgery.

portfolio.text:
Buttock Enhancement Turkey (Gluteal Augmentation)

Buttock enhancement Turkey is an operation performed to give the butt a round, firm and voluminous appearance and to eliminate aesthetic problems on or around the butt. Buttock Enhancement has become one of the most preferred aesthetic operations worldwide. Thanks to this operation, not only it is possible to enlarge the buttocks, it is also possible reduce or lift the butt. In the continuation of our article, we will be answering FAQs such as “How is buttock enhancement performed?”, “What is the recovery process after buttock enhancement?”, “Who can undergo buttock enhancement surgery?” and “How long does buttock enhancement last?”.

For detailed information about Turkey Buttock Enhancement surgeries and similar operations, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Istanbul Buttock aka Gluteal Enhancement?

Butt aesthetics is an aesthetic operation performed to give the butt a distinct, attractive and overall, a compatible appearance with the rest of the body. Thanks to the operations performed within the scope of butt aesthetics, it is possible to get rid of stretch marks, sagging and similar aesthetic problems in the butt area. Thanks to this operation, it is possible to lift, enlarge, reduce and reshape the butt. Within the scope of butt aesthetics, special applications such as BBL (Brazilian Butt Lift) can also be used. In this way, individuals can have an attractive and prominent butt appearance.

Why is Buttock Augmentation?

Buttock enhancement can be performed for purposes such as:

• To enlarge and redefine the butt.

• Reducing the butt and clarifying the butt line/the silhouette.

• To lift the butt.

• To eliminate sagging in and around the butt, thus creating a tight and youthful appearance.

• To create an appearance that is compatible with body lines.

Buttock Enhancement can be performed for the reasons mentioned.

Who Can get the Buttock Enhancement Surgery?

Buttock enhancement is performed on individuals who are over the age of 18. At earlier ages, the tissues that make up the hips may not have completed their development yet. That’s why such plastic surgeries are not performed on minors. Individuals who are of legal age can have butt aesthetics whenever they want.

Is Buttock Enhancement Permanent?

Buttock enhancement is a permanent operation. However, if healthy eating habits are not taken into consideration, lifestyle is not regulated and exercise is not performed regularly, the results obtained with butt aesthetics may be lost. Therefore, individuals planning to have butt aesthetics are advised to exercise regularly and adopt a healthy lifestyle after the operation.

How Long Does Buttock Enhancement Last?

Butt aesthetics is an operation that can take 3 to 6 hours. The duration of this operation may vary from person to person depending on the applications made during the operation. Likewise, the purpose of the operation may also affect the duration of butt aesthetics. After your doctor plans a special butt aesthetics for you, he will provide detailed information about the estimated duration of the surgery.

How is Buttock Aesthetics Done/How many types of Buttock Aesthetics are out there?

There are four different applications performed within the scope of buttock aesthetics. Some of these applications can be performed within the scope of a single operation:

• Buttock Augmentation: During buttock augmentation surgery, excess fat tissues taken from the patient’s own body or specially structured implant tissues are used. Thus, hip volume is increased and attractive buttocks are formed.

• Buttock Reduction: During buttock reduction surgery, excess tissues in the buttocks are removed. Thus, the buttocks are gained an elegant and attractive appearance that is compatible with the rest of the body.

• Buttock Lift: During butt lift surgery, the tissues in the butt are rearranged. Excess tissue that causes sagging can be removed or tissue can be added to the hip area to give the buttocks a lifted appearance. Butt lift surgery can also be performed during surgeries such as buttock reduction or buttock enlargement.

These operations are mostly performed under general anaesthesia. This prevents patients from feeling pain during surgery.

What is the Healing Process After Buttock Enhancement?

Individuals who have buttock enhancement are discharged 1 day after the operation. Individuals who are discharged should lie down and rest for a while. However, it is important that they pay attention to their lying and sitting positions. Likewise, it is not recommended to do heavy work or engage in movements that will strain the hip area such as climbing the stairs. It is possible for the patients to gradually return to their daily routines within 10 days. However, in this process, they should pay attention to some points recommended by the doctor until full recovery is achieved.

portfolio.text:
Temporal Lift Turkey

Temporal lift Turkey, also known as temporal eyebrow lift, is performed to give the upper part of the face an attractive appearance. Tissues in the temple area may lose their ideal position and sag over time, as a result, drooping of the eyebrows may occur. Some individuals have this appearance due to genetic reasons. This appearance can be eliminated during Temporal Lift surgery, in this way, an ideal appearance can be given to the eyebrows and problems such as wrinkles around the eyebrows and forehead can be eliminated. In the remaining of our article, we will be answering FAQs such as “How is temporal lift surgery performed?”, “How long does temporal lift take?”, “To whom can temporal lift be performed?” and “Is temporal lift painful?”.

For detailed information about Turkey temporal lift surgery and similar operations, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is a Temporal Lift aka Temporal Brow Lift?

Temple lift surgery is a special operation performed to eliminate sagging in the temple area, eliminate crow’s feet wrinkles and give the eyebrows an ideal position. Thanks to this operation, aesthetic problems in the upper part of the face can be carefully eliminated. Thus, the aesthetic integrity of the face can be reinforced. Ultimately, an extremely attractive and youthful facial appearance is created. This operation is also known by names such as eyebrow lift.

Where is the Temple?

Temple area; It is a hollow area between the ear, cheek, forehead and eye. The temples on both sides of the head may develop various aesthetic problems over time. These problems can be eliminated through operations known as temporal lift or temporal eyebrow lift.

Why is Temporal Lift Done?

Temporal lift can be performed for the following reasons:

• To eliminate wrinkles and sagging in the temple area.

• To ensure that the forehead area has a smooth appearance.

• To give the eyebrows an ideal position.

• To eliminate crow’s feet/wrinkles around the eyes.

• Tightening the eye area.

Temporal lift surgery can be performed for the aforementioned purposes.

To whom can Temporal Lift be performed?

Temporal lift surgery can be performed on any individual who is of legal age. This application is becoming more and more preferred every day both in the world and in our country. Nowadays, both women and men frequently consult plastic surgeons for a temporal lift surgery. However, temporal lift surgery is not recommended for individuals under 18 years of age. Minors must wait until they are 18 years old to have this operation.

Is Temporal Lift Turkey Painful?

Temple lift is not a painful operation. During this operation, the patient is given general anaesthesia. Thus, the patient can be prevented from feeling pain due to the procedures performed during the surgery. Anaesthesia applied during temporal lift surgery is planned by the doctor and anaesthesiologist specifically for the details of the surgery to be performed.

How Long Does Temporal Lift Last?

Temple lift surgery takes approximately 2 to 4 hours. In some cases, it is normal for the surgery to take up to 6 hours. Your doctor will provide detailed information about the estimated duration of temporal lifting surgery before the surgery.

How is Temporal Lift Done?

Before temporal lift surgery, a detailed interview is first held with the patient. During this meeting, the patient’s expectations from the surgery and the appearance they want to achieve are listened to. Then, various examinations are performed on the temple area. Ultimately, a surgery plan is made that meets the individual’s demands and aesthetic criterias.

When it comes to the surgery phase, the first procedure used will be general anaesthesia. Thanks to general anaesthesia, the patient is completely prevented from feeling pain and discomfort. During the procedures, the tissues in the temple area are rearranged and the targeted appearance is created. Thus, the surgery is completed.

What is the Healing Process After a Temporal Lift Turkey?

Individuals who have had a Temporal Lift surgery usually stay in the hospital for 1 night. The patients get discharged with special dressings and a bandage. The dressing is usually removed within 2 days but the bandage must be worn by the patients for up to 2 weeks. Patients in the recovery process are advised to sleep on their back for a while, avoid touching the temple area, and use the medications prescribed by the doctor regularly.

portfolio.text:
Vaser Liposuction Turkey

Vaser liposuction Turkey is a type of liposuction performed to remove fat tissues and to give the body shape a more defined look. In the traditional liposuction procedure, chemical liquids are used to separate fat tissues from other tissues. These fluids make it difficult to shape body lines in detail and require more meticulous work to do so. In vaser liposuction, it is possible to both remove stubborn fat tissues and carefully shape the remaining fat tissues. Moreover, this procedure promises a much more comfortable and faster recovery process. In the remaining of our article, we will be answering FAQs such as “What is the recovery process like after vaser liposuction?”, “How is vaser liposuction performed?”, “How long does Vaser liposuction last?” and “To whom can vaser liposuction be performed?”.

For detailed information about Turkey vaser liposuction and similar operations, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Vaser Liposuction?

Vaser liposuction is a modern liposuction technique that aims to shape body lines, remove excess fat tissues and enable the individual to have an attractive figure. During this operation, concentrated sound waves are used instead of chemical liquids to melt stubborn fat tissues. Thus, it is possible to melt fat tissues and shape body lines in a more precise manner. Vaser liposuction is extremely advantageous as it allows for more sensitive procedures and makes the healing process much more comfortable. This procedure is widely preferred by both women and men.

Why is Vaser Liposuction Done?

Vaser liposuction can be performed for purposes such as:

• Shaping the body lines precisely.

• To re-define the figure for giving the individuals a more appealing body shape.

• Removing fat tissues that cannot be lost by exercise or diet.

Vaser liposuction can be performed for such purposes. Although the main purpose of the procedure is not to enable the individual to lose weight, it is also possible to lose some weight thanks to vaser liposuction.

Who Can Have Vaser Liposuction?

Vaser liposuction can be performed on both male and female individuals who are of legal age. It is not appropriate to perform such aesthetic procedures on individuals under the age of 18. Adults can have vaser liposuction whenever they want, unless they have a health problem that contraindicates vaser liposuction.

What are the advantages of Vaser Liposuction Turkey?

The advantages of vaser liposuction include:

• Allowing the body contours to be shaped more precisely than that of liposuction with a traditional approach.

• It is a safe application.

• The healing process is much more comfortable and faster.

• Only target tissues are intervened.

• It takes place painlessly.

The advantages of vaser liposuction can be listed as above.

Is Vaser Liposuction Risky?

Vaser liposuction is an extremely safe liposuction technique. However, like every medical procedure, vaser liposuction has some risks. It should not be forgotten that the mentioned risks often arise because the procedures are performed by teams that are not competent in liposuction and the operations being held in operating rooms that have unsuitable environments for surgeries.

How Long Does Vaser Liposuction Take?

Vaser liposuction process is completed in approximately 1 to 1.5 hours. This procedure is generally faster than the traditional liposuction procedure. However, the duration of the application may vary depending on which body parts the procedure is performed on and its scope. Your doctor will provide detailed information about the estimated duration of the vaser liposuction procedure before the procedure.

How is Vaser Liposuction Turkey Done?

Vaser liposuction can be performed under local or general anaesthesia. After anaesthesia is given and patients become unconscious, surgical procedures begin. In this process, first a surgical incision is made to the target area. Then, using a special probe that emits concentrated sound waves is inserted through the incision, fat tissues are melted and evacuated out of the body with the help of a thin cannula, as in the traditional liposuction process. Thus, the vaser liposuction procedure is completed successfully.

What is the Recovery Process After Vaser Liposuction?

It is possible for individuals who have Vaser liposuction to be discharged on the same day as the procedure or to stay in the hospital for up to a day. After the patients are discharged, they are recommended to rest in bed and not do heavy work for 1 week. Afterwards, they can gradually return to their daily routines and work. It usually takes 3 to 4 weeks for them to fully heal. This timeline varies greatly depending on the details of the liposuction procedure.

faq.a: Vaser liposuction can be performed under local or general anaesthesia. After anaesthesia is given and patients become unconscious, surgical procedures begin. In this process, first a surgical incision is made to the target area. Then, using a special probe that emits concentrated sound waves is inserted through the incision, fat tissues are melted and evacuated out of the body with the help of a thin cannula, as in the traditional liposuction process. Thus, the vaser liposuction procedure is completed successfully.

faq.q: What is the Recovery Process After Vaser Liposuction?
faq.a: It is possible for individuals who have Vaser liposuction to be discharged on the same day as the procedure or to stay in the hospital for up to a day. After the patients are discharged, they are recommended to rest in bed and not do heavy work for 1 week. Afterwards, they can gradually return to their daily routines and work. It usually takes 3 to 4 weeks for them to fully heal. This timeline varies greatly depending on the details of the liposuction procedure.

portfolio.text:
Face Lift Turkey

Face lift Turkey is a special surgical operation performed to eliminate sagging and wrinkles on the face through rearrangement of facial tissues. Soft tissues, such as the fat tissues on the face, wear out over time due to both environmental factors and aging. Due to this wear and tear, they sag and make the individual appear older than they are. These tissues are rearranged during the operation known as facelift surgery or facelift aesthetics. Thus, aesthetic problems on the face were eliminated; A tight and youthful facial appearance is created. In the rest of our article, we will be answering FAQs such as “Why is face lift surgery performed?”, “How is face lift surgery performed?”, “Who can have face lift surgery?” and “How long does face lift surgery take?”.

For detailed information about Turkey face lift surgery and similar operations, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is a Face Lift aka Rhytidectomy?

Face lift is a special operation performed to rearrange facial tissues, eliminate sagging on the face, and create a youthful facial appearance. During this operation, excess tissues that cause sagging on the face are removed using various surgical techniques. The remaining tissues are repositioned using special methods such as hanging techniques. Thus, a smooth, young and dynamic facial appearance is created. Nowadays, face lift surgery can also be performed with endoscopic techniques. For detailed information on the subject, you can review the article titled Endoscopic Face Lift on our website.

Why is Face Lift Turkey Done?

Face lift surgery may be performed for reasons such as:

• To eliminate sagging in facial tissues and the appearance resulting from sagging.

• To eliminate wrinkles and lines on the facial skin.

• Removing the excess skin at the lower jawline an Deep skin folds from the sides of the nose to the corner of the mouth.

• To make the face look young, attractive and dynamic.

Face lift surgery can be performed for the mentioned purposes.

Who Can Have a Face Lift?

Face lift surgery is generally preferred by individuals over the age of 35. The reason for this is that the sagging in the tissues that make up the face reaches noticeable levels after the mentioned ages through collagen depletion. However, individuals who are of legal age can have face lift surgery at any age they want.

Is Face Lift Dangerous?

Face lift surgery is not a dangerous operation. However, like every surgical procedure, face lift surgery has some risks. These risks include complications such as unwanted tissue damage, bleeding, and postoperative infection. If the surgery is performed by a specialist in the field under appropriate operating room conditions, the risks mentioned will be extremely low.

How Long Does a Face Lift Turkey Take?

The purpose and scope of facelift surgery significantly affects the duration of the surgery. In some cases, face lift surgery takes up to 3 hours, and in other cases it can take up to 6 hours. Your doctor will make a special plan for you before the surgery and will inform you in detail about the estimated duration of the surgery.

Is Face Lift Surgery Painful?

Before the face lift surgery, the surgeon who will perform the surgery and a specialist anaesthesiologist will make a special anaesthesia plan for you. This will prevent you from feeling pain and discomfort during the surgery.

How is Face Lift Surgery Performed?

Different procedures can be performed during face lift surgery. This operation begins with anaesthesia. Then, surgical incisions are made to certain areas on the face. With the help of these incisions, excess skin and fatty tissues are removed. The remaining skin tissue is tightened to create a smooth facial appearance and eliminate sagging. Finally, the surgical incisions made at the beginning of the surgery are closed with special suturing techniques. Thus, the surgery is completed successfully.

What is the Recovery Process After Face Lift Surgery?

Individuals who have facelift surgery are usually advised to stay in the hospital for 1 to 2 nights following the surgery. During this process, special attention is paid to the care of patients. Individuals who are discharged enter a rapid recovery process. Over time, the swelling on their face decreases and the oedema disappears. Within approximately 1 month, the results achieved through surgery become more noticeable. During this process, the patient must follow the recommendations given by the doctor and use the prescribed medications regularly.

portfolio.text:
Preservation Rhinoplasty Turkey

Preservation rhinoplasty Turkey is a highly advanced rhinoplasty technique performed by preserving the cartilage, connective tissue and similar soft tissues in the nose. During traditional rhinoplasty surgeries, various procedures are performed to shape the target tissues and give the nose an aesthetic structure. Some of these procedures cause wear and tear to the soft tissues around the nose and a certain amount of damage. Accordingly, intense oedema and bruising are observed on the face after the surgery. In the preservation rhinoplasty technique, the tissues in question are not harmed, and all applications are performed by targeting only the tissues on which the procedure is planned. Thus, patients recover much faster after nose surgery and can return to their daily lives more quickly. In the rest of our article, we will be answering FAQs such as “How is protective rhinoplasty performed?”, “How long does protective rhinoplasty last?”, “What are the advantages of protective rhinoplasty?” and “To whom can protective rhinoplasty be performed?”.

For detailed information about Turkey preventive rhinoplasty and similar operations or treatments, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Preservation aka Protective Rhinoplasty?

Preservation rhinoplasty is the most modern surgical technique preferred during rhinoplasty surgeries today. This technique is becoming more popular day by day both in our country and in the rest of the world. The reason for this is that the soft tissues in the nose are not damaged during the operation.(These soft tissues include connective tissues, cartilages and fatty tissues). Since these tissues are not damaged during the surgery, patients recover much faster afterwards. While they are in the healing process, facial bruising and swelling is extremely minimal. Therefore, they can quickly return to their daily lives and work. Preservation rhinoplasty is also known among the public as protective rhinoplasty.

Why is Preservation Rhinoplasty Performed?

Preservation rhinoplasty may be performed for purposes such as:

• To correct the curvatures seen in the nasal bone.

• To eliminate the humpy appearance of the nose.

• To ensure that the nose has an aesthetically attractive and harmonious appearance with the face.

• Reducing the size of the nose.

• To eliminate the droopy nose tip.

Preservation rhinoplasty can be performed for the aforementioned reasons.

Who Can Have Preservation Rhinoplasty Turkey?

Preservation rhinoplasty is generally preferred by individuals who want to have an aesthetically pleasing nose but are hesitant about post-operative processes. It’s a great fit for the individuals who have a busy working life and cannot spare time for a long recovery process. However, it should be noted that preservation rhinoplasty can only be applied to an individual over the age of 18.

What are the Benefits of Preservation Rhinoplasty?

The advantages and benefits of Preservation rhinoplasty are:

• Only target tissues are intervened during surgery.

• The surgery is performed with extreme precision.

• Postoperative recovery period is shorter.

• Postoperative problems such as swelling, oedema and bruising are extremely minimal.

• Returning to daily routine is more rapid than that of traditional rhinoplasty.

• The tip of the nose does not become droopy after the surgery.

The advantages and benefits of preservation rhinoplasty can be listed as above.

Is Preservation Rhinoplasty Painful?

Preservation rhinoplasty is not a painful operation because patients are given anaesthesia before the surgery. The length and details of the anaesthesia procedure are specifically adjusted according to the scope and duration of the surgery. Thus, patients do not feel pain or discomfort during the surgery.

How Long Does Preservation Rhinoplasty Turkey Take?

The duration of preservation rhinoplasty Turkey surgery may vary depending on the procedures to be performed during the surgery. This operation usually takes about 2 hours. Your doctor will give detailed information about the duration of preservation rhinoplasty before the surgery.

How is Preservation Rhinoplasty Done?

During preservation rhinoplasty surgery, the patient is first anaesthetized. This prevents the patient from feeling pain and discomfort during the surgery. Then, previously planned changes are made with the help of procedures performed through the nostrils. During these procedures, important tissues in the nose are not damaged. Only target tissues are intervened.

What are the processes before and after Preservation Rhinoplasty?

Before preservation rhinoplasty Turkey, the doctor and the patient have a detailed meeting called the pre-surgical consultation. During this meeting, the patient’s expectations from rhinoplasty are listened to. Various measurements are taken from the nose, then, the details of the surgery are planned together with the patient. The patient is informed in detail about the surgery.

After preservation rhinoplasty, patients usually stay in the hospital for 1 night. They are then discharged. The oedema and bruising in their nose disappear to a large extent within 1 week. During this process, they can return to their daily lives with the guidance of their doctor.

portfolio.text:
Arm Lift Turkey (Brachioplasty Surgery)

Arm lift Turkey is an advanced surgical operation performed to tighten and slim the arms. In particular, sagging may occur in the arms due to factors such as rapid weight gain and loss, pregnancy and advancing age. These sagging can negatively affect the appearance of both the arms and the overall appearance of the body. Arm lift surgery is performed to eliminate these sagging, tighten the arms and eliminate the disharmony between the arms and the rest of the body. Thus, individuals can have sporty and attractive arms that are compatible with their bodies. This operation is generally preferred after procedures such as obesity/bariatric surgery and pregnancy. In the rest of our article, we will be answering FAQs such as “How is arm lift surgery performed?”, “How is arm lift surgery performed?”, “How long does arm lift surgery last?” and “Is arm lift surgery permanent?”.

For detailed information about arm lift surgery and similar operations or treatments in Turkey, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Arm Lift Surgery aka Brachioplasty?

Arm lift surgery is an operation performed to eliminate aesthetic problems in the area between the wrist and shoulders, eliminate the appearance of flabby arms(also known as bat wings) and eliminate incompatibilities between the arms. It is possible to use various surgical techniques and special applications such as liposuction during this operation. Arm lift Turkey is an operation that can be performed on both arms. Thanks to this operation, the arms can be thinned and the symmetry problems between the arms can be carefully eliminated.

Why is Arm Lift Performed?

Arm lift surgery can be performed for reasons such as:

• To eliminate sagging and stretch marks in the arms.

• To ensure that the arms have a harmonious appearance with each other.

• To ensure that the arms have aesthetic integrity with the rest of the body.

• To slim down the arms and add an aesthetic dimension to the arms.

• Creating a tight and attractive arm appearance.

Arm lift surgery can be performed for the aforementioned purposes.

Who Can Have Arm Lift?

Individuals who want to have arm lift surgery must be of legal age. Because during this operation, surgical procedures are performed for purely aesthetic purposes. Individuals whose arm tissues have completed their development and who are underage cannot therefore have arm lift surgery. Individuals over the age of 18 can have arm lift surgery whenever they want, unless they have a disease or an underlying condition that may prevent the operation to take place.

Is Arm Lift Surgery Risky?

Arm lift surgery carries some risks such as infection and bleeding. However, most of these risks arise because the operation is not performed under ideal operating room conditions and by an expert team. Therefore, choosing a doctor for arm lift surgery is extremely important.

Is Arm Lift Permanent?

The results achieved with arm lift surgery are maintained throughout life if a healthy eating habit and an ideal exercise routine are maintained. However, individuals who do not pay attention to their diet, do not exercise or engage in physical activity, and do not change their lifestyle may lose these results that had been obtained via brachioplasty over the years due to reasons such as weight gain.

How Long Does Arm Lift Turkey Take?

Arm lift Turkey may take up to 2 to 3 hours, depending on the techniques used during the surgery and the procedures performed on the arms. Your doctor will inform you in detail about the estimated duration of the surgery and similar issues.

How is Arm Lift Surgery Performed?

Various surgical procedures and applications such as liposuction may be used during arm lift surgery. These applications are mostly performed under general anaesthesia. Thus, patients do not feel pain during the operation and the operation can be performed ideally. During the surgery, the doctor may perform procedures such as arm thinning, arm stretching and arm tightening. These procedures are performed by removing excess fat and skin tissues from the arms. Procedures such as liposuction or vaser-liposuction can also be used to remove fat tissues. To get detailed information about the subject, you can review the articles titled Vaser-Liposuction and Liposuction on our website.

What is the Recovery Process After Arm Lift Turkey?

Individuals who have arm lift surgery can be discharged on the same day or stay in the hospital for one night, depending on the extent of the surgery they have undergone and their post-surgical state/wellbeing. Discharged individuals can gradually return to their daily lives after 2 to 3 weeks. You should not take a shower for the first two days after arm lift surgery and no movements that will strain your arms should be made until full recovery occurs.

portfolio.text:
Prominent Ear Surgery Turkey (Otoplasty)

Prominent ear surgery Turkey is performed to eliminate the prominent ear appearance that occurs as a result of inadequate development of ear tissues and to create an aesthetic harmony between the ears and the head. The prominent ear appearance is largely due to congenital causes and is usually noticeable before the individual starts primary school. It is possible to easily eliminate this appearance thanks to prominent ear surgery. Prominent ear surgery can be performed on adults as well as children over the age of 6. In the rest of our article, we will be answering FAQs such as “How is prominent ear surgery performed?”, “How long does prominent ear surgery take?”, “Is pain felt during prominent ear surgery?” and “At what age should prominent ear surgery be performed?”.

For detailed information about prominent ear aesthetics and similar operations or treatments in Turkey, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Otoplasty?

Protruding ear surgery is a special operation performed to ensure that the ears establish an ideal angle with the head and to eliminate the appearance of prominent ears. Thanks to this operation, the position of the ears can be rearranged. Thus, the prominent ear appearance is eliminated. The surgery can be performed on any individual from an early age. Individuals do not feel pain or discomfort during this surgery, which is performed under anaesthesia and under sterile operating room conditions.

What is a Prominent/Protruding Ear?

Protruding ears are a problem that occurs because the cartilages in the ear area are not sufficiently developed and/or are looser than the ideal level. This problem is usually noticed in childhood. If it is not treated at an early age, it can cause the individual to be bullied by his/her peers and have self-confidence problems. Therefore, it is recommended that prominent ear surgery be performed at an early/pre-school age, if possible.

What Causes Protruding Ears?

The prominent ear appearance occurs as a result of the cartilages that make up the ear not developing sufficiently. Since these cartilages are not sufficiently developed, the ears cannot establish a healthy connection with the head. In case of prominent ears, the angle between the head and the ears is greater than the ideal level. Having prominent ears usually occurs due to genetic reasons.

Why is Prominent Ear Surgery Turkey Performed?

Protruding ear surgery is performed to ensure that the ears achieve a healthy harmony with the head and to reduce the angle between the ears and the head. Thus, the prominent appearance is eliminated. Due to this appearance, secondary problems such as social pressure, exclusion, low self-confidence and bullying that the individual may be exposed to can also be prevented.

Is Prominent Ear Surgery Painful?

Protruding ear surgery is not a painful operation. Before this operation, the doctor, together with the anaesthesiologist, makes an anaesthesia plan specific to the length of the surgery, the individual’s age and the individual’s general health condition. Since the patient is put under anaesthesia before the surgery, he does not feel pain or discomfort during the procedures. Thus, prominent ear surgery is completed smoothly and painlessly.

How Long Does Prominent Ear Surgery Turkey Take?

Protruding ear surgery takes approximately 30 minutes for each ear. In other words, the operation is completed in approximately 1 hour. However, the duration may vary depending on the extent of the prominent ear problem and the type of technique used during the surgery. Your doctor will give detailed information about the estimated duration of prominent ear surgery before the surgery.

How is Prominent Ear Surgery Performed?

During prominent ear surgery, anaesthesia is first performed. Thus, the patient does not feel pain or discomfort during the surgery. Then, special surgical incisions are made behind the ears. Ears are treated through these incisions using special stitching and positioning procedures. This ensures that the ears gain a natural and harmonious appearance with the head. After the planned procedures are completed, the surgical incisions are closed and the surgery ends.

What is the Recovery Process After Prominent Ear Surgery?

Individuals who have prominent ear surgery are taken to a private room to rest for a few hours after the surgery. In this room, healthcare professionals carefully care and observe the individual. The individual’s parents may also come to this room. After the necessary procedures are completed, the patient is discharged. Discharged patients are prohibited for showering for several days. Likewise, they should regularly use the medications prescribed by the doctor. If possible, they should prefer a supine position while sleeping.

In case of prominent ears, the angle between the head and the ears is greater than the ideal level. Having prominent ears usually occurs due to genetic reasons.

faq.q: Why is Prominent Ear Surgery Turkey Performed?
faq.a: Protruding ear surgery is performed to ensure that the ears achieve a healthy harmony with the head and to reduce the angle between the ears and the head. Thus, the prominent appearance is eliminated. Due to this appearance, secondary problems such as social pressure, exclusion, low self-confidence and bullying that the individual may be exposed to can also be prevented.

Protruding ear surgery is not a painful operation. Before this operation, the doctor, together with the anaesthesiologist, makes an anaesthesia plan specific to the length of the surgery, the individual’s age and the individual’s general health condition. Since the patient is put under anaesthesia before the surgery, he does not feel pain or discomfort during the procedures. Thus, prominent ear surgery is completed smoothly and painlessly.

faq.q: How Long Does Prominent Ear Surgery Turkey Take?
faq.a: Protruding ear surgery takes approximately 30 minutes for each ear. In other words, the operation is completed in approximately 1 hour. However, the duration may vary depending on the extent of the prominent ear problem and the type of technique used during the surgery. Your doctor will give detailed information about the estimated duration of prominent ear surgery before the surgery.

faq.q: How is Prominent Ear Surgery Performed?
faq.a: During prominent ear surgery, anaesthesia is first performed. Thus, the patient does not feel pain or discomfort during the surgery. Then, special surgical incisions are made behind the ears. Ears are treated through these incisions using special stitching and positioning procedures. This ensures that the ears gain a natural and harmonious appearance with the head. After the planned procedures are completed, the surgical incisions are closed and the surgery ends.

faq.q: What is the Recovery Process After Prominent Ear Surgery?
faq.a: Individuals who have prominent ear surgery are taken to a private room to rest for a few hours after the surgery. In this room, healthcare professionals carefully care and observe the individual. The individual’s parents may also come to this room. After the necessary procedures are completed, the patient is discharged. Discharged patients are prohibited for showering for several days. Likewise, they should regularly use the medications prescribed by the doctor. If possible, they should prefer a supine position while sleeping.

How is a Tummy Tuck Turkey Done?
What is the Recovery Process After Tummy Tuck?

portfolio.text:
Tummy Tuck Turkey

Tummy tuck Turkey; is a special operation performed to create a slim and tight abdominal appearance. Thanks to this operation, individuals can get rid of sagging, cracks and lines in their abdominal areas. Abdominoplasty surgery is frequently preferred, especially after the processes such as bariatric surgery and post-pregnancy. In the rest of our article, we will be answering FAQs such as “How is mini tummy tuck surgery performed?”, “How long does tummy tuck surgery take?”, “Who can have tummy tuck surgery?” and “What is the recovery process like after tummy tuck surgery?”.

For detailed information about Turkey abdominoplasty and mini-abdominoplasty surgery, or similar operations/treatments you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Abdominoplasty aka Tummy-Tuck?

Abdominoplasty is an operation performed using special surgical techniques to eliminate sagging and stretch marks in the abdominal area. Thanks to this operation, aesthetic problems such as sagging in the abdominal area can be eliminated and a tight abdominal appearance can be achieved. During tummy tuck aesthetics, advanced procedures and surgical procedures such as liposuction are used. Thanks to these applications, an aesthetic integrity is created between the waist, abdomen and navel area. The tummy tuck aesthetic is planned by the doctor who performs the operation, completely in accordance with the individual’s demands and general aesthetic criterias.

What is Mini Tummy Tuck?

Mini tummy tuck is a smaller-scale aesthetic operation compared to the classic tummy tuck surgery. Procedures such as belly button positioning are generally not performed during this operation, and much more regional/small-scale operations are used. Therefore, the recovery period after mini tummy tuck is much shorter than that of a full tummy tuck.

Why is Tummy Tuck Done?

Abdominoplasty surgery can be performed for the following reasons:

• To eliminate sagging in the abdominal area caused by weight gain and similar factors.

• Slimming the abdomen and waist.

• To ensure that the abdomen and waist area gain an aesthetically attractive appearance.

• To eliminate stretch marks, wrinkles and similar aesthetic problems occurring in the abdominal area.

Abdominal stretching surgery can be performed for the mentioned purposes.

Who Can Have Tummy Tuck Surgery?

Tummy tuck surgery involves extremely comprehensive surgical procedures and applications. Therefore, this operation is not recommended for minors. However, individuals who have completed tissue development in the abdominal area and are over the age of 18 can have abdominoplasty surgery whenever they want. Individuals who are planning to become pregnant soon or are already pregnant are advised to have abdominoplasty surgery later on. The results achieved with tummy tuck surgery are usually not affected by the body changes that occur during pregnancy and are much more permanent.

Is Tummy Tuck Turkey Dangerous?

Abdominoplasty is not considered to be a risky operation. However, there are some factors that can make this operation dangerous and risky. These factors often arise because the operation is performed by a non-expert team under non-ideal operating room conditions. Therefore, choosing a doctor for abdominoplasty is extremely important.

Is Tummy Tuck Permanent?

Individuals who want to preserve the outcomes achieved with tummy tuck surgery for a lifetime are advised to exercise regularly after the surgery. Likewise, they are advised to regulate their eating habits and adopt a healthy lifestyle.

How Long Does a Tummy Tuck Take?

As we mentioned before, tummy tuck surgery is performed in two different ways. Total tummy tuck surgery takes approximately 3 to 4 hours. Mini tummy tuck surgery is usually completed within 1 to 2 hours. These periods may vary from person to person depending on the scope of the procedures performed during the surgery, your doctor will provide detailed information about the duration before the surgery during the consultation.

How is a Tummy Tuck Turkey Done?

General anaesthesia is used to prevent the patient from feeling pain during abdominoplasty and to ensure that the surgery is performed ideally. During the surgery, excess fat and skin tissues in the abdominal area are removed using special techniques. The remaining tissues are rearranged to create a tight abdominal appearance. In this process, the position of tissues such as the belly button can also be arranged in line with the purpose we mentioned. During the full tummy tuck surgery, the entire abdomen can be treated, and during the mini tummy tuck surgery, only the lower part of the abdomen can be treated.

What is the Recovery Process After Tummy Tuck?

Those who have abdominoplasty will have a planned stay in the hospital for 1 or 2 nights after the surgery. They are then discharged and allowed to return home. After abdominoplasty, movements that will force the abdominal area should not be made to avoid damaging the surgical area. You should rest in bed for at least a week, and only perform activities permitted by your doctor. Patients use a special corset during the recovery period after abdominoplasty. Thanks to this corset, the healing process will be more ideal and faster. It is possible to return to work 2 to 4 weeks after surgery, but some restrictions must be followed until full recovery occurs.

How Long Does Genital Aesthetics Turkey Take?
What are the things to consider after genital aesthetics?

portfolio.text:
Genital Aesthetics Turkey

Genital aesthetics Turkey are operations performed to eliminate aesthetic problems in the genital area and to provide the individual with a genital area that is both functional and aesthetic. Many procedures, both surgical and non-surgical, can be used within the scope of genital aesthetics. The operations performed by surgery include vaginoplasty (vaginal tightening surgery), labiaplasty (labia minora aka inner lip aesthetics), and clitoral hoodectomy/hoodoplasty(clitoris aesthetics). Non-surgical applications include G-spot enlargement, O-spot enlargement and genital PRP treatments. In the rest of our article, we will answer FAQs such as “How is vaginoplasty performed?”, “How is labiaplasty performed?”, “What are the things to consider after genital aesthetics?” and “How long does genital aesthetic surgery take?”.

For detailed information about Turkey genital aesthetic operations, non-surgical genital aesthetic treatments, or similar operations/treatments you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Genital Aesthetics?

These are operations performed to eliminate aesthetic problems in the vulva and vaginal canal, which are the outer and inner parts of the female genitalia respectively. Thanks to these operations, it is possible to eliminate mot of the functional and aesthetic problems. The genital area has an extremely sensitive structure and over time; It may change as a result of factors such as wear, advancing age and genetic predisposition. Thanks to operations such as vaginoplasty, labiaplasty and hoodoplasty performed within the scope of genital aesthetics, it is possible to eliminate the mentioned wear and tear and give the genital area an attractive appearance. These operations are performed through surgical procedures, however, some individuals prefer non-surgical genital aesthetic procedures which we will explain in the rest of our article.

What is Non-Surgical Genital Aesthetics?

Non-surgical genital aesthetic applications are performed with the help of filling procedures or anti-aging applications. Surgical procedures are not used during these applications. Therefore, they do not require anaesthesia most of the time. These applications include procedures such as genital PRP treatments, O-spot and G-spot enlargement. It is possible for the patient to return to daily routines immediately after these procedures.

Why is Genital Aesthetics Turkey Performed?

Applications and operations within the scope of genital aesthetics Turkey can be performed for the following purposes:

• To rejuvenate the genital area.

• To ensure that the genital area has more of a tidy/tucked appearance.

• To eliminate sagging of the vaginal lips.

• Narrowing the vagina.

• To enable the individual to get more pleasure from sexual intercourse and reach orgasm more easily.

• To rearrange the tissue called clitoral hood surrounding the clitoris and to eliminate sagging in this tissue.

Genital aesthetic applications can be performed for such reasons.

Who Can Get Genital Aesthetics?

Genital aesthetic operations include procedures performed for aesthetic and cosmetic purposes. In other words, these are not the type of operations that are mandatory and important for the health of the individual. For this reason, genital aesthetic applications are not performed on minors. Individuals who are over the age of 18 can have genital aesthetics whenever they want.

How Long Does Genital Aesthetics Turkey Take?

It is possible to use different operations and applications within the scope of genital aesthetics. Therefore, the duration of genital aesthetics may vary depending on the type of operation and application performed. Labioplasty operations are generally completed in 45 minutes, vaginoplasty operations in 60 minutes, and hoodoplasty operations in 30 minutes. Non-surgical genital aesthetic procedures generally take 15 to 20 minutes.

How is Genital Aesthetics Done?

During applications within the scope of genital aesthetics, general or local anaesthesia may be used. Thus, the patient can be completely pain free and comfortable during the applications. Genital aesthetic operations are performed as follows:

• Vaginoplasty: During the vaginoplasty operation, sagging and excess tissues in the patient’s vaginal canal are intervened. Excess tissues in this area are removed. The remaining tissues are rearranged. Thus, the vaginal canal is provided with a narrow structure. Thanks to vaginoplasty, the first 5 to 6 centimeters of the vaginal canal can be narrowed.

• Labioplasty: During the labiaplasty procedure, the inner vaginal lips are intervened. That’s why labiaplasty is also known as inner lip aesthetics. During this operation, sagging of the inner vaginal lips is eliminated. It is also possible to perform it in combination with hoodroplasty upon request.

• Hoodoplasty: During Hoodoplasty surgery, the tissue called clitoral cap located in the vulva that’s surrounding the clitoris is intervened. Sagging in this thin skin tissue is eliminated. Thus, a tidy appearance is created on the vulva. As we mentioned before, it is possible to perform it in a single surgery along with the labiaplasty operation.

Non-surgical genital aesthetic applications are generally performed with painless injection applications.

What are the things to consider after genital aesthetics?

Individuals who have genital aesthetics Turkey are generally discharged on the same day. After discharge, it is recommended that they wear comfortable underwear(not tight, also if possible, made from a material that’s mostly cotton) for a while, take a break from sexual intercourse for about 4 weeks, and not go to the sea or pool until full recovery.

Turkey Genital Aesthetics Prices

You can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS) for further information and up-to-date prices about the Turkey genital aesthetics, labiaplasty and vaginoplasty prices.
