headings.text: Why is Fox Eyes Surgery Done?
Who Can Have Fox Eyes Surgery?
Is Fox Eyes Surgery Turkey Painful?
How long Fox Eyes Surgery Lasts?
How Fox Eyes Surgery Turkey Is Done?

portfolio.text:
Fox Eyes Surgery Turkey (Almond Eye)

Fox eyes surgery Turkey is the specialised aesthetic procedure to create a more slanted, youthful and attractive look of the eyes and periorbital (around the eye) region. This look called “bella eyes”, “fox eyes” or “almond eye” is gaining immense popularity in world today. Therefore fox eyes (almond eyes) surgery is on high demand in almost all countries. Through this aesthetic procedure one can achieve a more attractive eye shape, get rid of old or tired look around the eyes and obtain a younger and fresher look. In the following part of our article, you’ll find information regarding “how almond eye surgery is done?”, “how long does the fox eye surgery last?”, “what is almond eye surgery?”, “how much fox eye surgery costs?”, “who can have almond eye surgery?”, “how long it takes to recover from almond eye surgery?”, “why almond eye surgery is done?”. For a more detailed information and a free consultation about almond eye surgery or similar procedure you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu, M.D., FEBOPRAS.

What Is Fox Eyes Surgery?

Fox eye surgery is the procedure to give the eyes an aesthetically more pleasant and attractive shape and an overall younger look to periorbital region. Through this procedure tissues surrounding eyes are rearranged in a favourable fashion. Thus eyes attain a more slanted shape, a more attractive gaze and excess skin & wrinkles are eliminated. Mild skin excess in the eyelids can also be addressed for, and an overall more harmonious appearance is obtained in periorbital region.

What is Fox Eye?

Almond eye is the eye shape in which outer corner (lateral canthus) of the eye is positioned higher on the horizontal axis than the inner corner (medial canthus) of the eye. This eye shape is observed in younger individuals and people with an overall attractive periorbital region, explaining the reason behind so many want to have similar look. And as the surgical techniques get more refined almond eye surgery is gaining more popularity each day.

Why is Fox Eyes Surgery Done?

Almond eye (fox eyes) surgery can be done for the following reasons:

• Eliminate aesthetic problems in the periorbital region

• Give eyes a more slanted look by elevating the outer corner of the eye

• Give individual a more attractive gaze

• Ameliorate minor aesthetic problems like skin excess or scleral show in eyelids

• Create a younger and more dynamic look around the eyes

Who Can Have Fox Eyes Surgery?

Any individual older than 18 years of age who’s looking for a more attractive eye shape, lifted eyebrows and midface can have this surgery. It’s one of the most widely performed facial aesthetic procedures nowadays in younger patients. Due to legal reasons minors under the age of 18 cannot undergo aesthetic procedures.

Is Fox Eyes Surgery Turkey Painful?

Luckily no, fox eye (almond eye) surgery is not a particularly painful procedure. Some throbbing, dull pain is common for the first couple of days and tension on the temporal area can trigger headaches in some of the patients but fortunately it’s tolerated well and necessitates painkiller use only for the first few days after surgery. Work and social life can be easily resume after 5-7 days.

Is Fox Eyes Surgery Permanent?

Short answer to this question is: yes, it is permanent. However one should take into consideration that gravity exerts a consant pull on all of the face, eyebrow, midface and outer corner of the eye (lateral canthus) are among the most affected regions. Meaning, in following years – on long term- these regions can sag again to some extent, but the effects of the procedure will be long standing and set the appearance back several years.

How long Fox Eyes Surgery Lasts?

Depending on the patient and surgical technique it can last from 45 to 90 minutes. It’s often performed under full (general) anesthesia and the patient is asleep during the whole time. If performed endoscopically or if the regions to be addressed (midface or even the lower face) are larger, the duration can be longer. Your surgeon will provide detailed information about the duration of the surgery and operative techniques and plan to you in prior to the surgery.

How Fox Eyes Surgery Turkey Is Done?

Fox eye (almond eye) surgery can be done in a number of ways. One technique is using temporal lift with incision (cuts) done inside the hear bearing skin of the temples and pulling the outer part of the eyebrow, corner of the eye (lateral canthus) and midface upwards using special stiches and anchoring them to temples. Temporal lift can be done either under direct vision or special camera systems called endoscopes hence the term “endoscopically”. Incisions for temporal lifting is traditionally one for each side measuring approximately 4 centimeters but can also be 3-4 shorter incisions for the use of endoscopes. Following induction of anesthesia a solution of local anesthetic and adrenaline in injected to area to reduce bleeding during the surgery and reduce the pain in post operative period. Incisions are made, the regions to be addressed are mobilized and lifted, both sides are evaluated for symmetry and incisions are closed. Depending on the type of anesthesia patients are kept under observation for a few hours or overnight and subsequently discharged.

Fox Eyes Surgery Turkey Prices

For price information regarding fox eye or almond eye surgery you can get in contact with Dr. Alper Burak Uslu.

How is Neck Lift Turkey Performed?
What To Expect Before Your Procedure And What Does The Healing Process Look Like After Neck Lift Turkey?

portfolio.text:
Neck Lift Turkey

Neck lift Turkey is an operation performed to tighten the skin tissue in and around the neck and to get rid of the sagging in this area. The neck area creates an aesthetic transition between the face, chin and décolleté area. Therefore, sagging of the mentioned areas may also negatively affect the existing aesthetic problems, making the patient insecure about the overall appearance of their face and neck. Problems such as sagging in the neck area, which develop as a result of weight gain and loss and similar factors, can be eliminated with neck lift aesthetics, thus, an attractive and elegant neck appearance can be created. In the rest of our article, we will answer FAQs such as “How is neck lift surgery performed?”, “How long does neck lift surgery last?”, ” Who is Suitable for the neck lift surgery?” and “Is neck lift surgery permanent?”.

For detailed information about Turkey neck lift surgery and similar operations or treatments, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Neck Lift?

Neck lift is an operation performed to eliminate sagging in the neck and décolleté area and to create an aesthetic appearance in the mentioned areas. Thanks to this operation, excess fat and skin tissue in the neck area can be removed. Thus, an aesthetic transition can be created between the face, chin, neck and décolleté area. Neck lift surgery is widely preferred by both men and women today. This operation is frequently performed especially after bariatric surgeries.

Why is Neck Lift Done?

Neck lift surgery can be performed for the following reasons:

• To remove excess fat and skin tissue in the neck area, thus eliminating sagging in the neck area.

• To ensure that the neck area creates an aesthetic transition between the jaw line and the décolleté area.

• To ensure that the neck area gains a young, firm and attractive appearance.

• Eliminating wrinkles and lines in the neck area.

Neck lift surgery can be performed for the aforementioned purposes.

Who İs Suitable for the Neck Lift Surgery?

Neck lift surgery is generally performed on middle-aged or older individuals. This is because connective tissues weaken and neck tissues sag with advancing age. However, some individuals may experience neck sagging as a result of excessive weight loss or similar factors. That’s why neck lift surgery is also frequently preferred by younger patients. Generally speaking, any individual over the age of 18 can have a neck lift aesthetic whenever they want, upon request.

Is Neck Lift Painful?

Neck lift surgery is not a painful operation. Before the surgery, an anesthesiologist and the surgeon who will perform the surgery make an anesthesia plan specific to the length of the surgery and the general health condition of the patient. In this way, the risk of the patient feeling pain and discomfort during the surgery is eliminated.

Is Neck Lift Permanent?

Neck tissues, which are stretched and adjusted thanks to neck lift surgery, may wear out again and sag over the years. The most effective way to prevent this is to exercise regularly, have a healthy diet plan and lifestyle. Your doctor will give a much more detailed information about this issue after the surgery.

How Long Does Neck Lift Take?

Neck lift surgery is generally completed within 3 to 5 hours. The neck is a large body area and all procedures performed during neck lift surgery are performed with great precision. Therefore, it is quite normal for the surgery to take longer than similar aesthetic operations.

How is Neck Lift Turkey Performed?

During neck lift surgery, anesthesia is first performed. Then, the tissues in the neck are rearranged within the plan prepared specifically for the patient by the doctor. Excess fat and skin tissue in this area is removed. The remaining skin tissue in the area is tightened using special techniques. Thus, the surgery is completed successfully.

What To Expect Before Your Procedure And What Does The Healing Process Look Like After Neck Lift Turkey?

Before neck lift surgery, the doctor and the patient have a detailed discussion. During this interview, the doctor examines the patient’s neck area. He takes note of the aesthetic problems he notices about this area. Then, he listens to his patient’s expectations from the surgery. In line with all these factors, he prepares a special surgery plan for his patient.

After neck lift surgery, patients usually stay in the hospital for 1 or 2 days. Discharged patients are advised to use their medications regularly and avoid movements that will cause a strain or hurt the neck area.

headings.text: What is Rhinoplasty aka Nose Job?
What is the Age Limit for Rhinoplasty?
What are the processes before and after rhinoplasty Turkey?

portfolio.text:
Rhinoplasty Turkey (Nose Job)

Rhinoplasty Turkey is a special operation performed to shape the nasal tissues and eliminate nose-related aesthetic problems. The nose, located in the center of the face, is of great importance for the aesthetic integrity and attractiveness of the face. Aesthetic problems in the nose can negatively affect the harmony of the face. Rhinoplasty is performed to both eliminate these negativities and create an attractive nose that is suitable for your facial features. In the rest of our article, we will answer FAQs such as “How is rhinoplasty performed?”, “What are the processes before and after nose surgery?”, “What is the age limit for rhinoplasty?” and “How is closed rhinoplasty surgery performed?”.

For detailed information about Turkey rhinoplasty and similar operations or treatments, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Rhinoplasty aka Nose Job?

Rhinoplasty is a special operation, also known in medical terms as rhinoplasty, which is performed to eliminate various aesthetic and functional problems related to the nose. Today, this operation can be performed using different techniques. These techniques include methods such as rhinoplasty surgery with an open approach, rhinoplasty surgery with a closed approach and piezo rhinoplasty. Thanks to rhinoplasty surgery, it is possible to eliminate deformities in the nasal bone, reduce the size of the nose to fit the face, lift the tip of the nose, eliminate the appearance of the crookedness and the hump on the nose. Moreover, thanks to these procedures, problems such as mouth breathing (not being able to breathe through the nose) can be solved.

Why is Rhinoplasty Performed?

Rhinoplasty can be done for reasons such as:

• To eliminate deformities in the nose that are associated with the nasal bone and cartilage structure and position.

• To ensure that the nose is in the harmony with the face.

• Reducing the size of the nose.

• To eliminate droopy nose tip/to lift the tip of the nose.

• Eliminating the hump of the nose.

• To eliminate problems related to breathing.

Rhinoplasty can be performed for such purposes.

Who Can Have Rhinoplasty?

Rhinoplasty can be performed on individuals who are dissatisfied with the appearance of their nose and want a nose that is compatible with their face. This application is one of the most frequently preferred aesthetic operations by both men and women.

Is Rhinoplasty Risky?

Rhinoplasty carries some risks such as post-operative bleeding and infection. However, the reason why these risks arise is that the surgery does not occur under ideal conditions and is performed by an inexperienced team. And also for such reasons, an unpleasant appearance that the individual never asked for or a nose that is inharmonious to the face may be seen as an outcome. Individuals who want to be protected from the aforementioned risks are advised to be careful when choosing a doctor for rhinoplasty.

Is Rhinoplasty Painful?

It is not possible to feel pain or discomfort during rhinoplasty. Because before rhinoplasty, the surgeon and anaesthesiologist who will perform the surgery plan an anaesthesia application specific to the general health condition of the individual and the details of the surgery. Thanks to this application, the patient does not feel anything during the surgery. Thus, the surgery is performed painlessly and ideally.

What is the Age Limit for Rhinoplasty?

The age limit for rhinoplasty is 18. Individuals under the age of 18 are not recommended to have rhinoplasty. However, in some special cases, rhinoplasty can be performed on minors with the approval of their parents.

How Long Does Rhinoplasty Take?

Rhinoplasty may take up to 2 to 3 hours, depending on the techniques used during the surgery and the purpose of the surgery. Your doctor will provide comprehensive information about the duration and similar details of the rhinoplasty surgery via the consultation before the surgery.

How is Rhinoplasty Turkey Performed?

As we mentioned before, rhinoplasty can be done with different techniques. In this article, we will talk about the approaches to the rhinoplasty, namely open and close rhinoplasty surgery. Although both approaches have their own pros and cons and that each approach is no better than the other, it’s usually all about the surgeon’s choice, and the individuals wants and needs. So this part will be all about explaining each method rather than advising or directing the candidate on choosing one method over another.

Open rhinoplasty surgery is an operation that is usually performed under general anaesthesia and is more comprehensive than closed rhinoplasty. In the first step of this operation, about a centimeter-sized incision is made at the midpoint of the nostrils. With the help of this incision, the nasal skin is lifted. Thus, complete view of the nasal structure and tissues is established. Then, the tissues in question are rearranged within the scope of surgery planning. During this procedure, much more comprehensive and detailed procedures can be performed compared to the nose surgery with the closed approach. After the procedures are completed, the incisions are stitched with aesthetic stitches and the surgery is completed.

Closed rhinoplasty surgery is usually performed under general anaesthesia, but in rare cases local anaesthesia may also be preferred. During closed rhinoplasty surgery, unlike open surgery, no incision is made on the outer part of the nose. Nasal tissues are manipulated and re-arranged with the help of special surgical tools inserted through the nostrils. The procedures performed during this surgery are smaller in scale. However, closed nose surgery is more advantageous because it leaves no scars and the healing process is faster.

What are the processes before and after rhinoplasty Turkey?

Before rhinoplasty, the doctor and the patient have a detailed interview called pre-operative consultation. During this interview, the patient’s expectations from rhinoplasty surgery are listened to. The nose appearance that the patient wants to achieve is discussed. The doctor also shares his ideas with the patient during this process. Ultimately, a personalized rhinoplasty plan is made in line with the individual’s wishes and the doctor’s experience. All procedures used during the surgery are performed according to this planning, so that the appearance of the nose after the surgery can be foreseen in advance.

After rhinoplasty surgery, patients can be discharged on the same day or stay in the hospital for 1 night. After the discharge, some points should be taken into consideration until full recovery. For example, you should lie on your back with your head elevated for a while, you should not shower before your cast removal appointment, you will be prohibited for blowing your nose for the first 6 weeks and your nose should not be touched for two days after the surgery. The full list regarding the aftercare and prescriptions will be shared with you post-operatively and you will be responsible of following them as the aftercare can affect the outcome of your surgery.

Turkey Rhinoplasty Prices

How Long Does Endoscopic Face Lift Take?
How is Endoscopic Face Lift Turkey Performed?
What are the Before and After Endoscopic Face Lift Processes?

portfolio.text:
Endoscopic Face Lift Turkey

Endoscopic face lift Turkey is an operation performed to tighten facial tissues with closed surgical methods, thus creating a youthful facial appearance without leaving any scars. During classical face lift surgeries, patients are left with relatively large scars in certain parts of the face. Nowadays, with the help of new and modern techniques, it is possible to have a face lift procedure without leaving any scars on the visible parts of the face. The minimal incisions made during this operation, known as endoscopic facelift, remain hidden on the scalp. Moreover, the healing process of this application is comparatively more comfortable and faster. In the rest of our article, FAQs such as “How is an endoscopic face lift performed?”, “What are the advantages of endoscopic face lift surgery?”, “Who can have an endoscopic face lift?” and “How long does an endoscopic face lift take?”.

You can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS) for detailed information about Turkey endoscopic face lift surgery and similar operations or treatments.

What is Endoscopic Face Lift?

Endoscopic face lift is a special operation performed through extremely small and well-hidden incisions to eliminate aesthetic problems such as sagging on the face. Endoscopic techniques are used during this operation. Thus, there is no need to make large surgical incisions in an important area such as the face during surgery. The small incisions performed are in the area of the scalp and are near impossible to notice from the outside. Another advantage of face lift surgery performed with endoscopic methods is that the recovery process being much faster than the classical method. Thus, there’s less downtime and individuals can return to their daily routines and work relatively quickly.

Why is Endoscopic Face Lift Performed?

Endoscopic facelift can be performed for purposes such as:

• To eliminate sagging on the face.

• Creating a youthful facial appearance.

• To remove wrinkles and lines on the face.

• To ensure that the individual has an attractive and lively face.

Endoscopic face lift surgery can be performed for such reasons.

Who Can Have Endoscopic Face Lift Turkey?

Endoscopic facelift surgery is extremely suitable for individuals who want to have a facelift but are afraid of some of the consequences of classical facelift surgery. This operation is generally preferred by individuals older than 35 years of age. However, if there is an underlying health or aesthetic concern that may enable the operation, anyone of legal age can have this operation.

What are the Advantages of Endoscopic Face Lift?

The advantages of endoscopic facelift include:

• The surgical incisions used during this operation are extremely small.

• Surgical incisions remain on the scalp and are not noticeable from the outside.

• There is no pain or discomfort during endoscopic face lift surgery.

• Recovery time is much shorter.

• Patients can return to work and daily life very quickly after surgery.

• Risks such as postoperative infection are relatively lower.

The advantages of endoscopic facelift can be listed as above.

Is Endoscopic Face Lift Painful?

Endoscopic facelift is not a painful operation. The most important reason for this is that the patient is anaesthetized before the surgery. During the surgery, patients are unconscious and do not feel any pain. Thus, the surgery takes place safely and comfortably.

How Long Does Endoscopic Face Lift Take?

Endoscopic face lift surgery is completed in approximately 1 to 2 hours. The duration of this operation is much less than that of classic face lift surgery.

How is Endoscopic Face Lift Turkey Performed?

During endoscopic face lift surgery, the patient is first put under general anaesthesia. Then, strategic surgical incisions are applied to the areas of the scalp. With the help of these incisions, the tissues on the face are manipulated. Sagging on the face is eliminated and the face is tightened with the help of special techniques. Thus, the changes aimed at surgery are successfully achieved.

What are the Before and After Endoscopic Face Lift Processes?

Before endoscopic face lift surgery, the doctor plans a special surgery for his patient. Thanks to this planning, the exact facial appearance requested by the patient is created.

After endoscopic face lift surgery, patients are stayed in the hospital for up to 1 night. Discharged patients must use prescribed medications regularly and carefully follow the aftercare recommendations given by the doctor.

headings.text: In which areas is liposuction done?
Can You Lose Weight with Liposuction?
How Long Does Liposuction Turkey Take?
What is the Recovery Process After Liposuction Turkey?

portfolio.text:
Liposuction Turkey

Liposuction Turkey is an application performed to remove fat tissues that have become stubborn/resistant to lose, thus, to enable the individual to achieve their ideal body shapes and contours. Individuals may have fat masses in their abdomen, waistline, hips, thighs and similar areas that do not go away with exercise or diet. These masses can hide the contours of the regions in which they are located and create a bulky appearance. Thanks to liposuction, it is possible to separate the mentioned fat tissues from other tissues in the area, shape the remaining fat tissues and remove the separated fat tissues from the body. In the rest of of our article, we will be answering FAQs such as “How is liposuction performed?”, “To which areas can liposuction be performed?”, “What is the recovery process like after liposuction?” and “To whom can liposuction be performed?”

For detailed information about Turkey liposuction procedure and similar operations or treatments, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Liposuction?

Liposuction is an application performed to remove excess fat tissue from various body parts, to re-contour the body lines and to enable the individual to have an attractive body shape that they ask for. There are stubborn fat masses in various parts of the body that cannot be lost by practices such as exercise or diet and these masses hide the body lines in the area where they are located. They can also harm the individual’s self-confidence due to the appearance they create. Liposuction is performed to remove the mentioned fat tissues in a safe and fast manner. Nowadays, this procedure can also be performed as vaser liposuction. To get detailed information about the subject, you can review the article titled Vaser Liposuction on our website.

Why is liposuction done?

Liposuction can be performed for purposes such as:

• Safely removing fat tissues that have become resistant to lose from the body.

• Re-contouring body lines that are important for the aesthetic integrity of the body.

• To help individuals in attaining an attractive figure that they’ve always dreamt of.

Liposuction can be performed for the reasons mentioned.

In which areas is liposuction done?

Liposuction can be applied to areas such as:

• Hips and hip transitions. (also can be applied to eliminate hip dips if the look is not caused by the position of the hip bone itself)

• Thighs.

• Legs.

• Arms.

• Abdominal and back area (incl. the area that creates the ‘’bra bulge’’).

• Chest area.

• Under chin/submental (to lessen or eliminate the ‘’double-chin’’)

• Axillary/Underarm area. (Arm Pit & Bra Bulge Liposuction can be combined for the individuals to be more comfortable wearing strapless clothes)

Liposuction can be performed on the mentioned areas to remove stubborn fat tissues.

Who Can Get Liposuction?

Liposuction is performed on individuals over the age of 18, it is not recommended for minors to have liposuction.

Can You Lose Weight with Liposuction?

Liposuction is not a procedure performed for weight loss purposes. However, during the liposuction process, it is possible to lose a certain amount of weight due to the removal of fatty tissues. The amount of weight an individual loses with this procedure may vary depending on the scope of the liposuction procedure and which areas it is applied to.

Is Liposuction Harmful?

Liposuction is not a risky practice in itself. However, there are some factors that can make this practice harmful or dangerous. The most important of these factors is that the liposuction procedure is performed under non-ideal conditions by teams that are not competent in this practice. Therefore, individuals who plan to have liposuction are recommended to receive service from a physician who is an expert in their field.

How Long Does Liposuction Turkey Take?

The liposuction process may take 1 to 2 hours, depending on which body parts the application is performed on and the extent of the liposuction. Before this application, your doctor will make a special surgical plan for you, based on both your demands and general aesthetic criterias. Since all procedures will be carried out according to this plan, you will be informed in detail about the estimated duration of liposuction before the application.

How is Liposuction Done?

Two different anaesthesia applications can be used to prevent the patient from feeling pain and discomfort during the liposuction procedure. The most preferred of these is general anaesthesia, although local anaesthesia can also be preferred for smaller-scale procedures. After the anaesthesia procedure is completed, a small surgical incision is made in the target body area of the patient. Through this incision, a liquid is administered that melts the fat tissues in the area and separates them from other tissues without damaging them. Then, the fats separated from the tissues thanks to this liquid are withdrawn through special pipes called cannulas. Thus, the liposuction procedure is completed successfully.

What is the Recovery Process After Liposuction Turkey?

Individuals who have liposuction with local anaesthesia can be discharged within two to three hours after the surgery. However, people who have liposuction under general anaesthesia may need to stay in the hospital for 1 night. faq.q: In which areas is liposuction done?

• Legs.

Liposuction can be performed on the mentioned areas to remove stubborn fat tissues.

How Long Does Breast Lift Surgery Take?
How is Breast Lift Surgery Performed?

portfolio.text:
Breast Lift Surgery Turkey

Breast lift surgery Turkey is an aesthetic operation performed to rearrange the breast tissues, shape the breasts and give the breasts a lifted appearance. Some individuals may have sagging breasts due to genetic and/or developmental reasons. Breast sagging may occur due to reasons such as excess fat and skin tissue in the breasts or the breast tissues not being supported properly. During breast lift surgery, all of these reasons are evaluated and a personalized operation plan is made. Thus, the sagginess degree of the breasts is reduced and the breasts are uplifted. In the remaining of our article, we will be answering FAQs such as “How is breast lift performed?”, “Is it possible to breastfeed after breast lift?”, “How is breast lift performed?” and “To whom can breast lift be performed?”

For detailed information about Turkey breast lift surgery and similar breast operations, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Breast Lift Surgery?

Breast lift surgery is a breast aesthetic operation performed to eliminate breast sagging and give the breasts a lifted look. During this operation, excess fat and skin tissue from the breasts can be removed to lift the breasts. Breast tissues can be repositioned to create an upright breast appearance. However, in some individuals, silicone implants can be placed in the chest area to lift the breasts. The details of the breast lift operation are planned completely individually.

Why is Breast Lift Performed?

Breast lift surgery can be performed for purposes such as:

• Eliminating breast sagging.

• Repositioning breast tissues.

• To ensure that the breasts have an upright structure.

• To ensure that the breasts have an attractive and youthful appearance.

Breast lift surgery can be performed for the reasons mentioned.

Can Breast Lift Be Performed Together with Other Breast Surgeries?

Breast lift surgery can be performed together with both breast enlargement and breast reduction operations. This variation of surgeries performed together is a right fit for individuals who wish can enlarge or reduce their breast size, while at the same time ensuring that their breasts have an upright structure. Thus, surgical planning at different times or having the need of multiple surgeries will not be necessary.

Who Can Have Breast Lift Surgery Turkey?

Individuals who want to have breast lift surgery must have completed their breast development. In other words, aesthetic operations such as breast lift are not recommended for minors. Likewise, individuals who are planning to become pregnant in the near future, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding are also advised to postpone their breast lift surgery for a while.

Is it possible to breastfeed after breast lift?

Individuals who have breast lift surgery can breastfeed after their recovery. During breast surgeries such as breast lift, milk ducts and mammary glands are not intervened.

Is Breast Lift Surgery Risky?

As with every surgical procedure, breast lift surgery also has some risks. Most of these risks arise because the operation is not carried out in an ideal environment by a team that is not competent in its field. Therefore, individuals who want to have a breast lift are advised to carefully select a doctor.

How Long Does Breast Lift Surgery Take?

Breast lift surgery is usually completed within 2 hours. If the operation is accompanied by breast enlargement or breast reduction procedures, this period may vary. After your doctor takes the necessary measurements of your chest area and listens to your expectations from the surgery, he will prepare a special surgery plan for you. Then, within the scope of this planning, he will inform you in detail about how long the operation is estimated to take.

How is Breast Lift Surgery Performed?

During breast lift surgery, if the patient’s general health condition is eligible, general anaesthesia is usually applied. In some cases, local anaesthesia and sedation may also be preferred. In both cases, patients do not feel pain during their breast lift surgery. Excess fat and skin tissue in the breasts can be removed using various special techniques during surgery. Tissues such as nipples can be rearranged, and if necessary, silicone implants can be placed in the target area to support the breast tissues. All these processes are usually completed within 2 hours.

What is the Recovery Process After Breast Lift Surgery Turkey?

Women who have a breast lift usually spend the night after the surgery in the hospital. Afterwards, they are discharged by the doctor. Individuals returning home should avoid heavy and tiring work or high impact physical activities for approximately 7 to 10 days and should rest during that period. Afterwards, they can gradually return to daily life and resume their exercise routine after consulting with their doctor.

Who Can Have Breast Augmentation Turkey?
How Long Does Breast Augmentation Surgery Take?
How is Breast Enlargement Surgery Performed?
What are the things to consider after breast augmentation Turkey?

portfolio.text:
Breast Augmentation Turkey

Breast augmentation Turkey is a special aesthetic operation performed to enlarge and shape the breasts. The size and shape of the breasts are extremely important for the aesthetic integrity of the female body. Some individuals may have small breasts due to genetic reasons. This is extremely natural. Some individuals with small breasts may want to enlarge their breasts due to their aesthetic preferences, and they may apply for breast augmentation aesthetics for this purpose. Thanks to breast augmentation surgery, it is possible to add volume to the breasts, shape the breasts and make the breasts have a more attractive appearance. This operation can be performed together with other breast surgeries such as breast lift and fat transfer (to the breasts). In the rest of our article, we will be answering FAQs such as “How long does breast augmentation surgery take?”, “How is breast augmentation surgery done?”, “Who can undergo breast augmentation surgery?” and “What are the things to consider after breast augmentation surgery?”.

For detailed information about Turkey Breast Augmentation surgery and similar operations, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Breast Augmentation aka a ‘’Boob Job’’?

Breast augmentation, also known as breast enlargement surgery or breast augmentation aesthetics, is an advanced operation performed to give the breasts a fuller appearance. During this operation, special materials such as medical implants are used to add volume to the breasts. These implants are carefully placed in the chest area to shape the breasts, enlarge them and give the breasts an upright structure. The implants in question can be placed in the breasts, through the nipples, under the breasts or under the armpits.

Why is Breast Augmentation Done?

Breast augmentation aesthetics can be performed for purposes such as:

• To add volume to the breasts and make them firmer and/or larger.

• Eliminating the size difference between breasts making them more symmetrical.

• Making adjustments to the position of the breasts.

• To ensure that the breasts gain an upright appearance.

Breast augmentation surgeries can be performed for the reasons mentioned.

Who Can Have Breast Augmentation Turkey?

Breast augmentation aesthetics is an aesthetic operation performed through surgical procedures. Therefore, this operation is performed on individuals who are over 18 years old and have completed their breast development. It is not recommended for minors to have breast augmentation surgery. In addition, individuals who are pregnant or breastfeeding are also advised to postpone their breast augmentation surgery for a while. During breast augmentation surgery, the mammary glands or milk ducts are not damaged, meaning breastfeeding can also be performed after the surgery. However, skipping the breastfeeding stage, thinking that it will have an effect on the appearance or results achieved from the surgery is a myth and may not be beneficial for the baby’s development to do so.

Breast Implants

There are many types of Breast Implants. Some of them are made of silicone, while some contain saline. The implant to be placed on the breasts during breast augmentation surgery are determined by the doctor’s instructions and the patient’s preferences.

Is Breast Augmentation Surgery Painful?

Breast augmentation surgery is painless, and this operation is often performed under effective anaesthesia such as general anaesthesia. Thus, the individual is prevented from feeling pain during the surgery.

Is Breast Augmentation Surgery Risky?

Breast augmentation surgery, like any surgical procedure, carries some risks. If the surgery is performed by a plastic surgeon specialist under ideal conditions, these risks are extremely low.

How Long Does Breast Augmentation Surgery Take?

Breast augmentation surgery takes approximately 1 to 2 hours, this time may vary slightly depending on the details of the procedure. Your doctor will provide comprehensive information about the duration of breast augmentation surgery.

How is Breast Enlargement Surgery Performed?

Breast augmentation surgery is performed under general anaesthesia to prevent the patient from feeling pain. During the surgery, structured or smooth implants are placed in the breasts from previously determined areas such as the nipple, breast or armpit. The incisions made to place the implants are closed with aesthetic sutures and the surgery is completed.

What are the things to consider after breast augmentation Turkey?

Patients are discharged on the day of the surgery or the following day. The patients need to pay attention to some points while they are in the recovery process. Things to consider after breast augmentation surgery include:

• The type of bra recommended by the doctor should be worn until the surgery area heals.

• Movements that will strain or hurt the operation area should not be made.

• Avoid swimming in the sea or swimming pool until recovery is complete.

• Prescribed medications should be used regularly.

• Strenuous sports should be stopped for a while.

Things to consider after breast augmentation surgery can be summarized as above.

Who Can Have The BBL Surgery?
How Long Does BBL Surgery Take?
What Does Recovery Process Look Like After BBL Turkey/What To Expect After The Operation?

portfolio.text:
BBL Turkey

BBL Turkey is an aesthetic surgery technique performed with special fat transfer procedures to give the hips an attractive appearance. Many applications and techniques can be used within the scope of hip aesthetics. BBL application is one of them. This procedure, performed alongside liposuction, has become one of the most preferred aesthetic operations worldwide. In the rest of our article, we will be answering FAQ’s such as “How is BBL surgery performed?”, “How long does BBL surgery take?”, “What does the recovery process look like after Brazilian butt aesthetics?” and “Is Brazilian butt aesthetics permanent?”

You can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS) for more information about Turkey Brazilian butt aesthetics and similar aesthetic operations or treatments.

What Is Brazilian Butt Lift a.k.a BBL?

BBL is a special hip aesthetic technique that has gained popularity in recent years and is preferred for shaping the hips. During this operation, the hips are given a round, voluminous and prominent appearance. However, there is an important point that distinguishes this operation from other hip aesthetics. In hip aesthetics performed within the scope of BBL, fat tissues taken from the individual’s own body through liposuction are used to shape the hips. In other words, silicone prostheses or fillers are not preferred. Thus, with the help of the fat harvested from patient, the hips can be shaped in a much more meticulous manner.

Why Is BBL Done?

Brazilian butt aesthetics can be performed for purposes such as:

• Shaping the buttocks.

• To make the buttocks look round and voluminous, thus helping the patients in achieving an hourglass figure.

• To make the hips look tight, attractive and young.

• To lift and define the buttocks.

Brazilian butt aesthetics can be performed for the purposes above.

Who Can Have The BBL Surgery?

Within the scope of BBL application, some surgical procedures and liposuction are used for aesthetic purposes. Therefore, BBL application is not suitable for individuals under 18 years of age. Individuals who are of legal age can have Brazilian butt aesthetics whenever they want, upon request. This application is one of the most preferred butt aesthetic techniques worldwide today.

Is BBL a Risky Procedure?

Contrary to popular belief, BBL is not a risky surgery. However, if it is not performed by an expert team under ideal operating room conditions, risks such as tissue damage and infection may be encountered post-operatively. Therefore, individuals who want to have BBL aesthetics are advised to choose their doctor carefully. The operation will be planned completely individually according to the patient’s wants and needs within the limits of the patients anatomy, thus the operation can be carried out safely.

Is BBL Turkey Permanent?

The appearance achieved with Brazilian butt aesthetics can be maintained for a lifetime with regular exercise, healthy diet and lifestyle. However, if the individual does not exercise after the procedure, does not follow the doctor’s recommendations and does not pay attention to their eating habits, the mentioned appearance may be lost. In other words, the permanence of Brazilian butt surgery depends on the individual.

How Long Does BBL Surgery Take?

Aesthetic operations such as BBL are shaped entirely in line with the wants and needs of the individuals. The doctor makes a personalized aesthetic plan based on both these factors and general aesthetic criterias. He then performs the surgery within these plans. Since the details of the surgery are determined individually, the duration of BBL application may vary from person to person. Brazilian butt aesthetic application is usually completed in 2 to 3 hours. After your doctor makes an individualized plan for you, he will inform you about issues such as the estimated duration of the surgery.

How Is BBL Performed?

BBL is a two-stage operation, in both of these stages, the patient is under anesthesia, so during the whole operation, the patient does not feel pain or discomfort. During the first stage, liposuction is performed to harvest excess fat, and these tissues are usually harvested from body areas such as hips, belly, chest area or legs (these areas may vary from patient to patient and determined before the consultation pre-operatively). Then, the removed fat tissues are prepared for the BBL process. In the second stage of the operation, the prepared fat tissues are carefully transferred to the hips within the scope of the previous surgery planning. Thus, the hips are given a round, prominent and attractive appearance.

What Does Recovery Process Look Like After BBL Turkey/What To Expect After The Operation?

Individuals who have had BBL are discharged 1 day after the operation. Individuals who had been discharged are expected to recover substantially within 3 to 4 weeks. During the first 2 weeks of the recovery process, you can gradually return to daily routine with the doctor’s recommendation. However, the patient should continue to pay attention to some points until their recovery is complete.

portfolio.text:
Eyelid Aesthetics Turkey

Eyelid aesthetics Turkey is an aesthetic operation performed to eliminate saggy or baggy eyelids and to create an appearance that makes the individuals look less tired, more youthful and well rested. Eyelids can wear out due to both advancing age and environmental factors. When this wear and tear is combined with genetic factors, problems such as eyelid ptosis aka sagging may occur. Thanks to eyelid aesthetics, it is possible to eliminate droopy or hooded eyelids, eyelid bags and similar aesthetic problems. Thanks to this operation, functional problems arising from the mentioned aesthetic problems can also be eliminated. In the rest of our article, we will answer FAQs such as “How is eyelid aesthetics performed?”, “How long does eyelid aesthetics take?”, “Who can have eyelid aesthetics?” and “What is the recovery process like after eyelid aesthetics?”.

For detailed information about Turkey eyelid surgery and similar operations or treatments, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Eyelid Aesthetics aka Blepharoplasty?

Eyelid aesthetics, which occurs due to sagging of the eyelids and the baggy appearance being more prominent due to couple aforementioned factors; is a special operation performed to eliminate aesthetic and functional problems. During this operation, the tissues that make up the eyelids can be rearranged. Excess tissues that cause sagging and bagging can be removed. Thus, the narrowed vision and tired appearance caused by eyelid sagging can be eliminated. This operation is completed faster compared to aesthetic procedures performed with similar manners, thus the recovery period is much shorter.

Why is Eyelid Aesthetics Performed?

Eyelid aesthetics can be performed for purposes such as:

• To eliminate sagging of the eyelids.

• To rearrange the tissues that make up the eyelids.

• To eliminate baggy eyelids.

• To eliminate the tired look caused by problems such as eyelid sagging or bags.

• Creating a much younger and more dynamic eye appearance.

Eyelid aesthetics can be performed for the reasons mentioned.

What Causes Droopy Eyelids?

There may be many reasons for eyelid sagging. The main reason for this is genetic predisposition. However, factors such as advancing age, environmental factors and sudden weight gain or loss can also cause eyelid sagging.

Who Can Have Eyelid Aesthetics Turkey?

Eyelid sagging usually begins to become a noticeable problem after the age of 35. That’s why operations such as eyelid aesthetics are generally preferred by middle-aged individuals. However, any individual over the age of 18 can have eyelid aesthetics upon request. If there is an infection in the eyelids or surrounding tissues, eyelid aesthetics may be postponed for a while until the underlying condition is eliminated.

Is Eyelid Aesthetics Painful?

Eyelid aesthetics is performed painlessly. The reason for this is that the patient is anesthetized before the surgery. Within the scope of pre-surgical planning (the planning made before the surgery via the consultation), the patient is placed under local or general anaesthesia. Thus, the patient does not feel pain or discomfort during the surgery.

How Long Does Eyelid Aesthetics Take To Perform?

Eyelid aesthetics is completed in approximately 1 hour. In some cases, the operation can be completed in as little as 45 minutes. Your doctor will give detailed information about the estimated duration of eyelid aesthetics.

How is Eyelid Aesthetics Turkey Done?

During eyelid aesthetics, as we mentioned before, anaesthesia is performed priorly. Thanks to this procedure, the patient will be completely pain-free from the procedures performed during the surgery. After the anaesthesia procedure is completed, the surgical operation begins. Within the scope of this operation, tissues that cause excess and therefore sagging in the eyelid are removed. The remaining tissues are rearranged to create an eyelid that is both aesthetic and functional. The surgery ends after the planned procedures are carried out in order.

What is the Healing Process After Eyelid Aesthetics?

Individuals who have eyelid aesthetics are generally discharged within the day of the operation. The patient’s recovery is majorly completed within their 1 week and return to their daily lives. It is recommended not to rub the eyelids during the healing process, to use the medications prescribed by the doctor regularly and to avoid behaviours that may damage the eyelids. Likewise, they are advised to sleep in a supine position (lying flat on their back) with their head elevated for a while.

What are the Benefits of Botox Turkey?

portfolio.text:
Botox Turkey

Botox Turkey is a special application performed to eliminate skin wrinkles and give the skin a smooth and youthful appearance. Under the facial skin there are muscle tissues that enable facial expressions and aid in facial expressions to occur. Wrinkles and lines may appear on the skin surface over time due to factors such as excessive use of these tissues and advancing age. Botox application is performed to eliminate these wrinkles and lines and to give the skin an attractive and youthful appearance. This application is also widely preferred to eliminate problems such as excessive sweating. In the remaining of our article, we will answer FAQ’S such as “How is botox done?”, “How long does botox last?”, “What are the things to consider after Botox?” and “To which areas can botox be applied?”

For further information about Botox Turkey application and similar non-surgical aesthetic procedures, you can contact Dr. Alper Burak Uslu (MD, FEBOPRAS).

What is Botox?

Botox is a procedure performed with the help of a special liquid called botulinum toxin, and is one of the most preferred non-surgical aesthetic applications both in our country and worldwide. Thanks to this procedure, it is possible to eliminate wrinkles and lines in many body areas. This procedure, which is considered extremely safe if performed by an expert plastic surgeon, can now be performed in private practices, private hospitals and private clinics.

Why is Botox Done?

Botox can be performed for many different purposes. The most common of these purposes is to get rid of wrinkles and lines in the target area, especially the face area. However, botox treatment can also be used to reduce the severity or frequency of headaches felt during migraine attacks. Likewise, botox can be performed to eliminate excessive sweating and to decrease the severity of hyperhidrosis. Regardless of the purpose for which botox is requested, your doctor will plan all procedures specifically for your needs and demands.

Who Can Get Botox Turkey?

Botox procedure is mostly performed for cosmetic and aesthetic purposes. For this reason, like many aesthetic applications, botox is not recommended for minors. Individuals over the age of 18 can have botox upon request. However, there should not be an open wound, active infection or herpes in the area where they plan to have botox. Otherwise, the botox procedure may be postponed for a while until the aforementioned conditions disappear.

To Which Areas Can Botox be Applied?

Botox can be applied to areas such as:

• Around the eyes to eliminate crow’s feet wrinkles.

• Around the nose to remove wrinkles and lines around the nose.

• Around the mouth to eliminate lines around the mouth and lips.

• For forehead lines, apply to the forehead area.

• To the cheek area for aesthetic problems around the cheekbone.

• To the armpits and facial areas to eliminate excessive sweating.

• As part of migraine treatment with Botox, apply to the forehead and around the temple.

Botox procedure can be applied to such areas.

What are the Benefits of Botox Turkey?

Benefits of Botox include:

• Its effectiveness for removing wrinkles and lines.

• Its preventative application to the muscle tissue in the area that’s working excessively thus causing premature wrinkles.

• Its aid in the individuals to achieve a vibrant, smooth and attractive appearance by allowing the muscles to relax in a controlled manner.

The benefits of Botox can be listed as above.

Is Botox Permanent?

The effects of botox are not permanent, these effects usually last for 4 to 6 months and then disappear over time. The said period may vary depending on the individual’s skin type, lifestyle and dietary habits.

Is Botox Turkey Repeatable?

Individuals who have had botox before can have their botox procedure renewed upon request. This process is generally repeated every 6 months. Your doctor will inform you in detail about issues such as at what intervals the botox procedure can be repeated.

How Long Does Botox Last?

The botox process can be completed in approximately 15 minutes. Before this procedure, your doctor will make a completely personalized botox plan for his patient. That’s why all procedures during botox are carried out quickly, by your doctors planning via the consultation before the procedure.

How is Botox Performed?

Botox procedure is one of the most comfortable and painless applications for the patient among non-surgical aesthetic applications. In the first step of this application, a cream with an anaesthetic effect is applied to the skin area where the botox injection will be made. After the numbing effect of the cream begins, botox liquid is injected into the target area and the application is completed. Individuals who have botox can continue their daily routines after the procedure is completed.

pages.title: Über mich
pages.text:
Dr. Med. Alper Burak Uslu (FEBOPRAS)

Facharzt für Plastische, Rekonstruktive und Ästhetische Chirurgie

Dr. Alper Burak Uslu wurde 1988 in Ankara geboren. Er absolvierte seine Grundschul-, Mittel- und Oberschulausbildung an den Ankara Private Tevfik Fikret Schools und erhielt das „Baccalauréat Français“ (französisches Abiturzeugnis). Obwohl er von der medizinischen Fakultät der Universität Montpellier angenommen wurde, die als älteste medizinische Fakultät der Welt gilt, begann er 2005 seine medizinische Ausbildung an der medizinischen Fakultät der Universität Ankara Başkent, schloss sie 2011 ab und erhielt den Titel „Doktor der Medizin“. “.

Er zeigte große Erfolge bei der medizinischen Facharztprüfung und wurde 2012 in die Abteilung für Plastische, Rekonstruktive und Ästhetische Chirurgie des Ankara Numune Training and Research Hospital (ANH) aufgenommen und schloss 2017 seine Facharztausbildung in derselben Klinik ab. Während dieser Jahre nahm er teil an viele Kongresse und Schulungen. Im Jahr 2014 erhielt er eine mikrochirurgische Ausbildung an der Goethe-Universität Frankfurt, Deutschland. Während seiner Facharztausbildung führte er zahlreiche Operationen in den Bereichen ästhetische Chirurgie, Handchirurgie, rekonstruktive Mikrochirurgie, Mund- und Kieferchirurgie, Verbrennungen, Kopf- und Halskrebschirurgie und -rekonstruktionen, Traumata und Rekonstruktionen der unteren Extremitäten durch. Im Jahr 2017 nahm er an den zweistufigen schriftlichen und mündlichen Qualifikationsprüfungen teil, die von der Türkischen Gesellschaft für Plastische, Rekonstruktive und Ästhetische Chirurgie und dem European Board of Plastic Surgery (EBOPRAS) im Jahr 2018 organisiert wurden, und bestand diese beim ersten Versuch erfolgreich und erhielt die Auszeichnung die türkische und europäische Board-Qualifikation.

Dr. Alper Burak Uslu leistete zwischen 2018 und 2020 seinen Pflichtdienst als Facharzt für Plastische, Rekonstruktive und Ästhetische Chirurgie am Karaman Staatliches Krankenhaus, arbeitete zwischen 2020 und 2021 am Istanbul Haseki Training and Research Hospital und beteiligte sich an der Ausbildung von Assistenzärzten sowie seine akademischen Studien. Im September 2021 wurde seine medizinische Ausbildung durch die Landesverwaltung Münster bestätigt. Im Jahr 2021 verließ er seinen Pflichtdienst und begann hauptsächlich im Bereich der ästhetischen Chirurgie im Vanity Cosmetic Surgery Hospital zu arbeiten und ist weiterhin als freiberuflicher Arzt im Bereich der ästhetischen Chirurgie tätig. Dr. Uslu, der Perfektion als oberstes Ziel ansieht, ist der Meinung, dass Chirurgen sich ständig weiterentwickeln und an ihre Grenzen gehen sollten, um ihr Ziel zu erreichen und den Patienten die bestmögliche Behandlung zu bieten.

Er hat zahlreiche wissenschaftliche Artikel in nationalen und internationalen Fachzeitschriften veröffentlicht und zahlreiche Vorträge auf nationalen und internationalen Kongressen gehalten. Er ist Mitglied der International Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgeons (ISAPS), der American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS), des European Board of Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery (EBOPRAS), der Aesthetic Plastic Surgery Association (EPCD) und der Turkish Plastic, Reconstructive and Verband für ästhetische Chirurgie (TPRECD). Er spricht fließend Englisch, Französisch und Deutsch.

pages.title: Startseite
pages.text:
Dr. Med. Alper Burak Uslu

Facharzt für Plastische, Rekonstruktive und Ästhetische

Dr. Uslu ist ein angesehener europäischer und türkischer doppelt zertifizierter plastischer Chirurg. Er gehört zu den besten plastischen Chirurgen seiner Generation. Sein Qualifikations- und Fachwissen wird durch umfangreiche Zertifizierungen internationaler Gremien dokumentiert. Er ist stolzes Mitglied mehrerer angesehener Organisationen, darunter der International Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgeons (ISAPS), der American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS), der Turkish Society of Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery und der Turkish Society of Aesthetic Surgery. Außerdem ist er Fellow des European Board of Plastic Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery (EBOPRAS). Dr. Uslu schloss sein Studium an der Medizinischen Fakultät der Baskent-Universität in Ankara im Jahr 2011 ab und schloss 2017 seine sechsjährige Facharztausbildung in plastischer, rekonstruktiver und ästhetischer Chirurgie am Ankara Numune Research and Education Hospital ab. Er hat seine Fähigkeiten in einer fortgeschrittenen mikrochirurgischen Ausbildung an der Goethe-Universität in Frankfurt weiter verfeinert.

Die Gleichwertigkeit seiner medizinischen Ausbildung wurde durch die Bezirksregierung Münster anerkannt. Dr. Uslu hat ein besonderes Interesse und Fachwissen in den Bereichen ästhetische Gesichts- und Brustchirurgie, Körperformung, medizinische Ästhetik, rekonstruktive Mikrochirurgie und Handchirurgie und ist Autor zahlreicher internationaler Artikel, die in Fachzeitschriften mit Peer-Review veröffentlicht wurden.

Seine Arbeit wurde weltweit über 35-mal zitiert. Im Laufe seiner 12-jährigen Karriere hat er mehr als 2000 ästhetische Eingriffe und über 4000 plastische Operationen durchgeführt und dabei stets sein Engagement für Spitzenleistungen und Patientenversorgung unter Beweis gestellt.Mehr…

Warum Uns Wählen?

Internationale Anerkennung, Mitgliedschaft in den renommiertesten Gesellschaften für plastische Chirurgie, Auszeichnungen, höchste Ausbildungsniveaus und vor allem Tausende hervorragender Ergebnisse und zufriedener Patienten aus der ganzen Welt

Ihre Sicherheit und Ihr Wohlbefinden stehen immer an erster Stelle. Wir beurteilen die Eignung jedes Eingriffs in Ihrem Fall, setzen modernstes Wissen und Können sowie modernste Technologie und Instrumente ein, um Ergebnisse auf dem neuesten Stand zu erzielen. Um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen, passen wir jeden Eingriff Ihren spezifischen Bedürfnissen und Wünschen an und achten bei Planung, Durchführung und Nachsorge sorgfältig auf jedes Detail. Effektive Kommunikation ist von größter Bedeutung und wir werden Sie mit unserem engagierten und hochqualifizierten Team rund um die Uhr von Anfang bis Ende und während Ihres gesamten Genesungs- und Nachsorgeprozesses unterstützen. Schönheit durch ästhetische Chirurgie zu schaffen ist unsere Leidenschaft und wir glauben an ständige Verbesserung für Spitzenleistungen, die unseren Ruf widerspiegeln und zu ihm beitragen.

headings.text: In welchen Bereichen können Fettauffüllungen angewendet werden?
Wer kann sich mit Fett auffüllen lassen?
Wie lange dauert die Fettauffüllung Türkei?

portfolio.text:
Fettauffüllung Türkei

Fettauffüllung Türkei ist eine spezielle Anwendung, die durchgeführt wird, um die Gesichtskonturen zu formen und den Volumenverlust in bestimmten Hautbereichen zu beseitigen. Unter der Hautoberfläche befindet sich Fettgewebe, das der Haut ein lebendiges und voluminöses Aussehen verleiht. Wenn sich dieses Gewebe im Laufe der Zeit auflöst und abnutzt, kommt es zu Einbrüchen an der Hautoberfläche. Diese Einbrüche können dazu führen, dass der Betroffene älter und müder aussieht. Um dieses Erscheinungsbild zu beseitigen, wird eine Fettauffüllung durchgeführt. Gleichzeitig können Bereiche, die für die Gesichtsform wichtig sind, wie z. B. die Kieferlinie, dank dieser Anwendung geklärt und geformt werden. Das bei diesem Verfahren verwendete Fettgewebe wird dem eigenen Körper entnommen. Mit anderen Worten: Bei der Fettauffüllung wird kein fremdes Füllmaterial verwendet. Im weiteren Verlauf unseres Artikels werden wir auf neugierige Fragen wie “Wie lange dauert die Fettauffüllung?”, “Wie wird die Fettauffüllung im Gesicht durchgeführt?”, “Bei wem kann die Fettauffüllung im Gesicht durchgeführt werden?” und “An welchen Stellen wird die Fettauffüllung durchgeführt?” eingehen. Für detaillierte Informationen über die Fettauffüllung und die Anwendung der Fettunterspritzung können Sie sich an Op. Dr. Alper Burak Uslu wenden.

Was ist eine Fettauffüllung?

Die Fettauffüllung ist ein spezielles Verfahren, das mit körpereigenem Fettgewebe durchgeführt wird und im Allgemeinen zur Beseitigung von Volumenverlusten unter der Haut bevorzugt wird. Vor diesem Verfahren wird zunächst Fettgewebe aus einer fettreichen Körperregion entnommen. Dieses Gewebe wird in der Regel mit einer kleinflächigen Fettabsaugung entfernt. Nachdem das Fettgewebe entnommen und für die Auffüllung vorbereitet wurde, wird es auf die Zielbereiche aufgetragen.

Warum wird eine Fettauffüllung durchgeführt?

portfolio.text:
Vaser Liposuktion Türkei (Vaser-Fettabsaugung)

Vaser liposuktion Türkei ist eine spezielle Fettabsaugung, die durchgeführt wird, um Fettgewebe zu entfernen, das die Körperkonturen verdeckt, und um die Körperkonturen zu klären. Bei der klassischen Fettabsaugung wird das Fettgewebe mit mechanischer Kraft von anderen Geweben getrennt. Diese Flüssigkeiten machen es schwierig, die Körperkonturen detailliert und sorgfältig zu formen. Bei der Vaser-Liposuktion ist es möglich, sowohl hartnäckiges Fettgewebe zu entfernen als auch das verbleibende Fettgewebe sorgfältig zu formen. Außerdem verspricht dieses Verfahren einen wesentlich angenehmeren und schnelleren Erholungsprozess. Im weiteren Verlauf unseres Artikels beantworten wir Fragen wie “Wie ist der Heilungsprozess nach einer Vaser liposuktion?”, “Wie wird eine Vaser liposuktion durchgeführt?”, “Wie lange dauert eine Vaser liposuktion?” und “Bei wem wird eine Vaser liposuktion durchgeführt?”. Für detaillierte Informationen über die Vaser liposuktion und ähnliche Anwendungen können Sie sich an Op. Dr. Alper Burak Uslu wenden.

Was ist Vaser Liposuktion?

Die Vaser liposuktion ist eine moderne Fettabsaugungstechnik, die durchgeführt wird, um Körperkonturen zu formen, überschüssiges Fettgewebe zu entfernen und der Person attraktive Körperkonturen zu verleihen. Wird auch als Vaser- Fettabsaugung genannt. Bei dieser Anwendung werden anstelle von mechanischer Kraft verstärkte Schallwellen eingesetzt, um hartnäckiges Fettgewebe gegen das Schmelzen zu bringen. So ist es möglich, Fettgewebe zu schmelzen und Körperkonturen äußerst präzise zu formen. Die Vaser liposuktion ist äußerst vorteilhaft, weil sie ein präziseres Vorgehen ermöglicht und der Heilungsprozess angenehmer ist. Dieses Verfahren wird sowohl von Frauen als auch von Männern bevorzugt.

Warum wird eine Vaser Liposuktion durchgeführt?

Die Vaser liposuktion kann unter anderem zu folgenden Zwecken durchgeführt werden

• Um die Körperkonturen präzise und detailliert zu formen.

• Zur Verdeutlichung der Linien, die dem Körper ein attraktives Aussehen verleihen.

• Um Fettgewebe zu entfernen, das sich durch Sport oder Diät nicht auflöst.

• Um eine partielle Straffung der Haut zu erreichen

Die Vaser liposuktion kann zu diesen Zwecken durchgeführt werden. Obwohl der Hauptzweck des Eingriffs nicht darin besteht, Gewicht zu verlieren, ist es möglich, dank der Vaser liposuktion etwas Gewicht zu verlieren.

Bei wem kann eine Vaser Liposuktion durchgeführt werden?

Die Vaser liposuktion kann sowohl bei volljährigen Männern als auch bei Frauen durchgeführt werden. Derartige ästhetische Eingriffe sind für Personen unter 18 Jahren nicht geeignet. Wenn volljährige Personen keine gesundheitlichen Probleme haben, die einer Vaser-Liposuktion entgegenstehen, können sie sich jederzeit einer Vaser liposuktion unterziehen.

Was sind die Vorteile der Vaser Liposuktion?

Zu den Vorteilen der Vaser liposuktion gehören die folgenden:

• Sie ermöglicht eine viel präzisere Formung der Körperkonturen.

• Es handelt sich um eine sichere Anwendung.

• Der Heilungsprozess ist wesentlich angenehmer und schneller.

• Es wird nur in das Zielgewebe eingegriffen.

• Sie wird schmerzfrei durchgeführt.

So lassen sich die Vorteile der Vaser liposuktion aufzählen.

Ist die Vaser Liposuktion Türkei riskant?

Die Vaser liposuktion ist eine äußerst sichere Fettabsaugungstechnik. Wie jedes medizinische Verfahren birgt jedoch auch die Vaser liposuktion einige Risiken. Es darf nicht vergessen werden, dass die oben genannten Risiken oft dadurch entstehen, dass die Eingriffe von Teams durchgeführt werden, die keine Erfahrung mit der Fettabsaugung haben, und zwar in ungeeigneten Operationssälen.

Wie lange dauert die Vaser Liposuktion?

Das Verfahren der Vaser liposuktion ist in etwa 2 bis 5 Stunden abgeschlossen, je nach dem zu behandelnden Bereich. Dieses Verfahren ist im Allgemeinen schneller als die klassische Fettabsaugung. Die Dauer der Anwendung kann jedoch je nach Körperpartie und Umfang des Eingriffs variieren. Ihr Arzt wird Sie vor dem Eingriff ausführlich über die voraussichtliche Dauer der Vaser liposuktion informieren.

Wie wird die Vaser Liposuktion durchgeführt?

Vaser liposuktion Türkei kann unter örtlicher Betäubung oder Vollnarkose durchgeführt werden. Nachdem die Anästhesie abgeschlossen ist, wird mit dem chirurgischen Eingriff begonnen. Bei diesem Verfahren wird zunächst ein chirurgischer Schnitt im Zielgebiet gesetzt. Dann wird mit einer speziellen Sonde, die verstärkte Schallwellen aussendet, das Fettgewebe geschmolzen und die Körperkonturen werden geformt. Das geschmolzene Fettgewebe wird wie bei der klassischen Fettabsaugung mit Hilfe einer dünnen Kanüle aus dem Körper herausgeleitet. Damit ist das Verfahren der Vaser liposuktion erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

Wie ist der Erholungsprozess nach einer Vaser Liposuktion Türkei?

Patienten, die sich einer Vaser liposuktion unterziehen, können noch am Tag des Eingriffs entlassen werden oder einen Tag im Krankenhaus bleiben. Nach Abschluss des Krankenhausaufenthalts wird den Patienten empfohlen, 1 Woche lang Bettruhe einzuhalten und keine schweren Arbeiten zu verrichten. Danach können sie allmählich in ihren Alltag und ihr Arbeitsleben zurückkehren. Die vollständige Genesung dauert in der Regel 3 bis 4 Wochen. Dieser Zeitraum hängt weitgehend von den Einzelheiten des Fettabsaugungsverfahrens ab.

portfolio.text:
Piezo Rhinoplastik Türkei

Piezo rhinoplastik Türkei ist eine fortschrittliche Technik, die bei Rhinoplastik-Operationen eingesetzt wird. Bei klassischen Nasenkorrekturen wird physische Kraft eingesetzt, um Gewebe wie das Nasenbein zu formen und Verformungen dieses Gewebes zu beseitigen. Dies hat zur Folge, dass das umliegende Gewebe bis zu einem gewissen Grad durch diese Eingriffe in Mitleidenschaft gezogen wird, was nach der Operation zu Blutergüssen und Schwellungen im Bereich der Nase führt. Bei der Piezo rhinoplastik werden verstärkte Schallwellen zur Formung des genannten Gewebes eingesetzt. Es wird also nur in das Zielgewebe eingegriffen. Außerdem ist es dank dieser Anwendung möglich, viel präzisere Eingriffe an der Nase vorzunehmen. Im weiteren Verlauf unseres Artikels beantworten wir Fragen wie “Wie wird eine piezo rhinoplastik durchgeführt?”, “Wie lange dauert eine piezo rhinoplastik?”, “Wer kann sich einer piezo rhinoplastik unterziehen?” und “Wie ist der Heilungsprozess nach einer piezo rhinoplastik?”. Für detaillierte Informationen über die piezo rhinoplastik und ähnliche Operationen können Sie Op. Dr. Alper Burak Uslu kontaktieren.

Was ist Piezo Rhinoplastik?

Die piezo rhinoplastik ist eine moderne und vorteilhafte Rhinoplastik-Operation, bei der das Nasengewebe mit Hilfe von Ultraschallwellen geformt werden kann. Dank dieser Operation muss bei der Formung des Nasenbeins keine physische Kraft aufgewendet werden. So werden andere Nasengewebe oder Gewebe in der Umgebung der Nase während des Eingriffs nicht abgenutzt oder beschädigt. Dank der Piezo-Rhinoplastik können Krümmungen und Verformungen des Nasenbeins vorsichtig beseitigt werden. Die Formgebung der Nase kann äußerst präzise durchgeführt werden. Diese spezielle Nasenkorrekturtechnik wird von Tag zu Tag von immer mehr Menschen bevorzugt.

Warum wird eine Piezo-Rhinoplastik durchgeführt?

Eine piezo rhinoplastik kann unter anderem zu folgenden Zwecken durchgeführt werden

• Beseitigung von Problemen mit dem Nasenbein, ohne die Weichteile rund um die Nase zu beschädigen.

• Zur Beseitigung des Erscheinungsbildes einer gewölbten Nase.

• Um eine ästhetische Harmonie zwischen Gesicht und Nase herzustellen.

• Korrektur der Krümmung des Nasenbeins.

• Anhebung der Nasenspitze.

• Verkleinerung der Nase, um sie mit dem Gesicht in Einklang zu bringen.

Die Anwendung der Piezo rhinoplastik kann aus den genannten Gründen durchgeführt werden.

Wer kann sich einer Piezo-Rhinoplastik unterziehen?

Eine piezo rhinoplastik kann bei Personen durchgeführt werden, die sich einer Nasenoperation unterziehen möchten, aber Angst vor postoperativen Blutergüssen und Schwellungen haben. Ein gewisses Maß an Schwellungen und Blutergüssen ist nach dieser Operation normal. Diese sind jedoch geringer als die Komplikationen, die bei klassischen Nasenkorrekturen auftreten und verschwinden viel schneller. Jede Person über 18 Jahren kann sich auf Wunsch einer piezo rhinoplastik unterziehen. Diese Operation kann sowohl bei Männern als auch bei Frauen durchgeführt werden.

Was sind die Vorteile der Piezo Rhinoplastik?

Zu den Vorteilen der Piezo rhinoplastik gehören die folgenden:

• Diese Operation wird äußerst schonend durchgeführt.

• Während des Eingriffs werden keine Operationen durchgeführt, die auf physischer Kraft beruhen. Daher werden andere Gewebe nicht beschädigt.

• Da die Weichteile nicht verletzt werden, sind Beschwerden wie Blutergüsse und Schwellungen geringer.

• Der Heilungsprozess ist wesentlich angenehmer und verläuft schneller.

So lassen sich die Vorteile der Piezo-Rhinoplastik aufzählen.

Ist die Piezo Rhinoplastik schmerzhaft?

portfolio.text:
Brustverkleinerung Türkei

Brustverkleinerung Türkei ist eine Operation, die durchgeführt wird, um überschüssiges Fett- und Hautgewebe in den Brüsten zu entfernen und die Probleme zu beseitigen, die durch große Brüste entstehen. In der Öffentlichkeit herrscht der Irrglaube, dass große Brüste immer ein attraktives Erscheinungsbild vermitteln. In den meisten Fällen sind Brüste jedoch nur dann attraktiv, wenn sie eine Struktur haben, die zueinander und zu den Körpermaßen wie der Schulterbreite passt. Bei manchen Menschen sind die Brüste viel größer als das, was als ideal angesehen wird. Dies führt sowohl zu ästhetischen als auch zu funktionellen Problemen. Die ästhetische Brustverkleinerung wird durchgeführt, um diese Probleme zu beseitigen. Im weiteren Verlauf unseres Artikels beantworten wir Fragen wie “Warum wird eine Brustverkleinerung durchgeführt?”, “Wie lange dauert eine Brustverkleinerungsoperation?”, “Wer kann sich einer Brustverkleinerungsoperation unterziehen?” und “Kann man nach einer Brustverkleinerung stillen?”. Für detaillierte Informationen über die Brustverkleinerungsästhetik und ähnliche ästhetische Brustoperationen können Sie sich an Op. Dr. Alper Burak Uslu wenden.

Was ist eine Brustverkleinerung?

Die Brustverkleinerung ist eine Operation, die durchgeführt wird, um die Brüste entsprechend den individuellen Bedürfnissen und ästhetischen Kriterien zu verkleinern und Probleme wie Erschlaffung, Rücken-, Schulter- und Taillenschmerzen, Ausschläge unter der Brust und durch BH-Träger verursachte Schultereinbrüche zu beseitigen. Dank dieses Eingriffs kann die Person attraktive Brüste haben, die mit den Körpermaßen kompatibel sind. Außerdem ist es möglich, diese Operation zusammen mit einer Bruststraffung durchzuführen. Auf diese Weise erhalten die Brüste ein aufrechtes und ästhetisches Aussehen, das zueinander und zu den Körpermaßen passt.

Warum wird eine Brustverkleinerung durchgeführt?

Eine Brustverkleinerung kann zu folgenden Zwecken durchgeführt werden:

• Die Brüste sollen so verkleinert werden, dass sie mit den Körpermaßen, z. B. der Schulterbreite, kompatibel sind.

• Um den Größenunterschied zwischen den Brüsten zu beseitigen.

• Um die Brüste in eine attraktive Form zu bringen.

• Zur Beseitigung von Rücken- und Nackenschmerzen, die durch große Brüste verursacht werden.

Die ästhetische Brustverkleinerung kann aus den genannten Gründen durchgeführt werden.

Wer kann sich einer Brustverkleinerung unterziehen?

Ästhetisch-chirurgische Eingriffe wie die Brustverkleinerung werden nur bei volljährigen Personen durchgeführt. Personen, die volljährig sind und deren Brustentwicklung abgeschlossen ist, können sich auf Wunsch jederzeit einer Brustverkleinerung unterziehen. Frauen, die schwanger sind oder stillen, wird jedoch empfohlen, diese Operation erst nach Abschluss der vorgenannten Prozesse durchzuführen. Wenn eine Schwangerschaft in naher Zukunft geplant ist, wird eine ästhetische Brustvergrößerung nach der Schwangerschaft und der Geburt empfohlen.

Ist Stillen nach einer Brustverkleinerung möglich?

Frauen, die sich einer Brustverkleinerung unterzogen haben, können ihr Baby nach Abschluss des Heilungsprozesses stillen. Entgegen der landläufigen Meinung werden bei der Brustästhetik zwar einige der wichtigen Gewebe, die das Stillen ermöglichen, wie z. B. Milchdrüsen und Milchgänge, entfernt, aber die meisten von ihnen werden nicht beschädigt. Daher können Personen, die sich einer Brustästhetik unterzogen haben, ihre Babys nach der Geburt stillen.

Können Brustverkleinerung und Bruststraffung zusammen durchgeführt werden?

Die Ästhetik der Bruststraffung kann zusammen mit der Ästhetik der Brustverkleinerung durchgeführt werden. So können die Brüste in einer einzigen Operation sowohl verkleinert als auch gestrafft werden.

Ist eine Brustverkleinerungsoperation Türkei riskant?

Eine Brustverkleinerung birgt wie alle anderen chirurgischen Eingriffe auch Risiken. Die meisten dieser Risiken lassen sich jedoch durch die Wahl des richtigen Arztes und die Bereitstellung einer idealen OP-Umgebung ausschließen.

Wie lange dauert eine Brustverkleinerungsoperation?

Die Dauer einer Brustverkleinerungsoperation kann je nach Größe der Brüste, der während der Operation bevorzugten Methode und ähnlichen Faktoren variieren. In der Regel ist der Eingriff innerhalb von 2 bis 4 Stunden abgeschlossen. Ihr Arzt wird für Sie eine spezielle ästhetische Planung der Brustverkleinerung erstellen und Sie ausführlich über die Dauer des Eingriffs informieren.

Wie wird die Brustverkleinerungsoperation durchgeführt?

Die ästhetische Brustverkleinerung kann unter Vollnarkose oder örtlicher Betäubung durchgeführt werden. Die Operation wird unter sterilen OP-Bedingungen im Rahmen eines vom Arzt individuell erstellten Operationsplans durchgeführt. Bei der Operation können spezielle Techniken wie ” Umgekehrtes T” oder “Lollipop Schnitt” angewendet werden. Dank dieser Techniken werden überschüssiges Fett- und Hautgewebe in den Brüsten entfernt. Die während des Eingriffs verwendeten Schnitte werden mit speziellen ästhetischen Nahtverfahren verschlossen, und die Operation ist beendet. Der Eingriff ist für die Patientinnen schmerz- und beschwerdefrei.

Wie verläuft der Genesungsprozess nach einer Brustverkleinerungsoperation?

Nach einer Brustverkleinerung ist es möglich, dass die Patientin noch am selben Tag entlassen wird oder über Nacht im Krankenhaus bleibt. Patientinnen, die entlassen werden, wird empfohlen, ihre tägliche Arbeit für etwa eine Woche zu unterbrechen und keine schweren und anstrengenden Tätigkeiten auszuüben. Danach können sie entsprechend den Empfehlungen des Arztes in den Alltag zurückkehren.
